jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontend
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Frontend Core team, working closely with engineering and design to build something truly world-class. You'll bring a deep knowledge of web technologies and passion for engineering excellence to drive impactful architecture and design decisions. Your work will shape the Suno experience for millions and set a new bar for performance, accessibility, and delight.

Check out our Suno version of the job here: https://suno.com/s/2VV6IqHJ6L76pIbH

What You’ll Do

  • Architect the component libraries, shared abstractions, and foundational TypeScript and React code

  • Make it easy for feature teams to do the right thing through tooling and infrastructure that keeps quality high without sacrificing velocity

  • Drive a culture of high-quality craft through code review, documentation, and hands-on collaboration with engineers across the org

  • Accelerate feature development by scaling a rich component library with an emphasis on reusability and a consistent and accessible user experience

  • Write tests, documentation, and structured briefs that make agentic development workflows reliable

  • Identify pain points and drive technical improvements through thoughtful, incremental refactors

  • Design and build highly interactive, performant experiences for exploring and listening to music

  • Obsess over the performance, accessibility, and craft of our products

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years experience shipping production web apps

  • Advanced expertise in TypeScript, React, NextJS, CSS

  • Experience building complex responsive web apps that are modular and maintainable

  • Experience translating ambitious prototypes into production-ready code without compromising on quality, accessibility, or delight

  • An obsession with great user experiences, getting the details right, and iterating rapidly

  • Strong communication skills with experience collaborating across engineering, design, and product teams

  • Passion for web performance metrics and a healthy fear of red numbers


Nice to Have

  • Experience building developer tooling and automation pipelines

  • Familiarity with design systems and building shared component libraries

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows

  • A love of music (listening, exploring, making) is a huge plus

Additional Notes: Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. 

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $220K – $280K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno’s platform teams build the foundation upon which everything else is built, from our products at scale to our internal processes. We’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to work on one of the teams that powers the entire company: Infrastructure, Platform, and Leverage These teams work on a range of complex challenges, from the lowest layers of compute, to the platforms that 70+ engineers build on daily, to the AI-native tools and workflows that catalyze how everyone at Suno works, to the core creation surface where millions of people make music.

During the interview process we’ll work with you to find the team that’s the best mutual fit based on your background, technical strengths, and what gets you excited. What all of these teams share: they’re building foundational systems at scale, they own their work end-to-end, and their output directly determines how fast and how well Suno can build and ship products. They solve hard problems with autonomy and a bias toward engineering excellence.

Check out the Suno version of the job here: https://suno.com/s/3NcdjuEOnlHGMoBt

What You’ll Do

On one of Suno’s platform teams, you’ll work on a subset of the complex challenges outlined below:

  • Build the platforms that 70+ engineers depend on to ship product quickly and safely — APIs, authentication, deployment tooling, backend-driven configuration, and similar

  • Manage migrations that help teams transition off legacy systems seamlessly and without risk

  • Collaborate with engineering teams across the company to understand their needs and build the right abstractions

  • Build shared infrastructure, agentic tooling, and workflows that enable AI-native development across the company

  • Define best practices, frameworks, and evaluation systems for how Suno uses tooling in daily work

  • Partner closely with engineering and non-engineering teams to understand their needs and build the right solutions

  • Architect and build services to handle write-heavy consumer traffic and data

  • Design systems that are performant, secure, scalable, and easy to observe

  • Build and operate distributed databases, caching layers, and storage systems at consumer scale

  • Scale Kubernetes infrastructure and control planes to support rapid product and ML growth

  • Design inference infrastructure that keeps AI workloads fast, reliable, and cost-efficient

  • Build the foundational infrastructure for next-generation song creation: a multi-modal music agent, a create platform that powers multiple song creation products, and a realtime API enabling live generation and radio experiences

  • Operate with ambiguity — scope what matters, move fast, and drive projects forward independently as the space evolves

  • Own systems end-to-end — from design through deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence

  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, reliability, and maintainability

What You’ll Need

To succeed on one of Suno’s platform teams, your experience and skill set might resemble a cross section of the following:

  • 5–7+ years of infrastructure, backend, or systems engineering experience

  • Experience building and operating systems at significant scale in production

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud services (AWS/GCP), and modern infrastructure patterns

  • Expertise in infrastructure and platform security best practices

  • Ability to reason through hard scaling, reliability, and performance problems with clear technical judgment

  • Technical leadership or management experience

  • Experience building internal systems 0→1 — auth, notifications, CDN, or similar

  • Experience with websockets, streaming traffic patterns, and audio/video delivery

  • Familiarity with backend API design patterns at scale to serve internal backend, web and mobile clients alike

  • Experience on a platform or developer experience team where your primary customers were other engineers

  • Ability to manage system migrations with multiple dependent engineering teams

  • A working knowledge of security best practices in building and scaling infrastructure

  • Hands-on familiarity with the current landscape of AI for software engineering including, but not limited to: models, agents, coding assistants, and agentic workflows

  • Experience building or operating agent orchestration, tool calling, or streaming LLM generation systems

  • Experience building a streaming or realtime protocol in production — streaming generation, chat/turn-based UI, or live progress feeds

  • Shipped APIs consumed by iOS and Android clients in production; mobile-friendly API design is second nature

  • Observability is part of how you ship — you instrument before launch, not after

  • Mentorship experience — you’ve actively developed junior or mid-level engineers, not just worked alongside them

  • Strong product instincts — you synthesize user needs and build the right abstraction

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving problem spaces

  • High ownership — you drive projects end-to-end without waiting for direction

  • Strong product instincts — you synthesize user needs and build the right abstraction

  • Strong communication skills — you keep stakeholders informed and reduce ambiguity for the teams you serve

  • Strong written communication — patient and educator-minded when rolling out tools that change how people work

  • Strong oncall instincts — triage, debug, and resolve incidents across a distributed stack

  • A love of music, whether you’re an avid listener or musician yourself

Additional Notes

  • This role is based in Cambridge, MA (Boston).

  • This role is expected to work from the Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno’s company policy.

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Staff / Senior Software Engineer, Product Teams
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno is growing fast, and we’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to work on the products that define how people experience music on our platform. We have multiple teams tackling different dimensions of this challenge — from how content reaches users, to how users connect with each other, to how AI gives music a visual identity.

You’ll apply once, and during the interview process we’ll work with you to find the team that’s the best mutual fit based on your background, technical strengths, and what gets you excited. What all of these teams share: they’re building consumer-facing products at scale, they own their systems end-to-end, and they thrive on rapidly turning ambiguous problems into world class production-grade products. They have a nose for impact, and take on work from the 2-character performance fixes all the way through introducing brand new company-wide products, directly driving Suno’s top-line company goals.

Check out our Suno version of the job here: https://suno.com/s/OOxz00UgGKVmC3gY

What You’ll Do

Regardless of team, you’ll:

  • Own products and systems end-to-end — from scoping what to build, to shipping, to monitoring and iterating post-launch

  • Build backend and full-stack systems that serve millions of users with high performance and reliability

  • Design clean, scalable APIs consumed by web, iOS, and Android clients

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and peer engineering teams

  • Run experiments, instrument metrics, and make data-informed decisions about what to build next

  • Communicate proactively and with high bandwidth — concise & information-dense async updates, stakeholder alignment, low entropy

  • Raise the technical bar through code quality, architectural thinking, crisp abstractions, and mentorship

Areas You Could Work On

We’re hiring across several product areas. During the process, we’ll match you to the one that fits best. Here’s a flavor of the kinds of problems our teams are solving:

  • Building and optimizing content feeds, playback systems, and discovery experiences that make listening on Suno feel instant and personalized

  • Creating the social layer that turns Suno from a creation tool into a creative network — profiles, follow graphs, engagement notifications, publishing flows, and new social formats

  • Developing AI-powered visual products that give music a visual identity — generative cover art, AI music videos, and image-to-video experiences using cutting-edge inference models all the while inventing novel interface design patterns that keep the human front-and-center.

  • Partnering with recommendation systems to make content more personalized and relevant over time

  • Designing mobile-first APIs and working hand-in-hand with iOS and Android engineers

  • Reducing inference costs and latency for AI-generated content at consumer scale

What You’ll Need

Required

  • 5-7+ years of software engineering experience

  • Backend or full-stack experience building consumer products at scale

  • Strong API design skills — you’ve built APIs consumed by multiple client teams and have opinions about how they should work

  • A generalist, get-it-done attitude paired with genuine technical depth in at least one area

  • Comfort with high ambiguity — you can scope what matters, make tradeoffs, and drive forward without a fully defined spec

  • Excellent communication skills — your written updates are clear and dense, and you collaborate well across teams

  • Product intuition — you think about the end user in addition to the system

Strong Plusses (one or more of the following)

  • Experience with feed architecture, recommendation systems, content ranking, or search/retrieval at scale

  • Experience shipping social product features (follow graphs, notifications, engagement systems, publishing flows) at a consumer company

  • Power user of social media with genuine intuition for why engagement mechanics work (familiar with network effects, NFX literature, creator dynamics)

  • Hands-on experience with AI image and/or video model inference — diffusion models, token-based inputs, LoRA tuning, inference optimization

  • Full-stack capability including modern frontend (React, TypeScript, NextJS)

  • Mobile-first API design experience working directly with iOS/Android teams

  • Experience building 0→1 products and existing on existing products in a startup environment

  • Web experience with Python, Django, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Postgres, Redis

  • Technical leadership experience

  • A love of music, whether you’re an avid listener or musician yourself


Additional Notes

  • This role is based in New York City.

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $228K – $363K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Software Engineer, Trust and Safety

About Suno

Suno is a music company for the next generation of creators. Its AI-powered platform makes it easy for anyone to create original music. Built by musicians and engineers, Suno empowers users to turn ideas into fully produced tracks in minutes and unlocks a more rewarding music making experience full of endless new creative possibilities. Whether you're a first-time songwriter or a seasoned artist, Suno helps you make music that's meaningful, personal, and uniquely yours.

About the Role

Suno is hiring a Software Engineer, Trust and Safety, to safeguard the platform millions of creators call home. You'll be the line of defense between our community and the abuse, fraud, and harmful content that threatens it — building the systems that keep Suno a place people can trust with their creativity.

What You'll Do

You'll bring together a group of engineering teams under a shared roadmap, set the technical bar across that group, and grow the managers and engineers who report to you. You'll work closely with the other Senior Engineering Managers and with senior product, design, and data science partners to make sure your teams' work connects to Suno's broader strategy.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/c3oBVSyd2ywwKIcc

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical direction across your pillar, setting architecture strategy and ensuring scalable, high-quality systems that serve millions of creators

  • Manage and coach a group of Engineering Managers — setting a hiring bar, running effective performance cycles, and building a culture where teams do their best work

  • Partner with senior product, design, and data science leaders to define multi-team roadmaps, sequence bets, and ship features that move the needle

  • Navigate the full development lifecycle from ideation through launch across multiple teams simultaneously, managing tradeoffs and removing blockers at the organizational level

  • Champion engineering craft across your pillar — code quality, robust testing, and the right balance of rapid iteration with long-term maintainability

  • Represent your pillar in cross-functional planning and leadership discussions, connecting day-to-day execution to Suno's broader strategy

  • Contribute to Suno's mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by delivering the tools and platform that turn imagination into music

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years managing software engineering teams in a direct-to-consumer product organization, including experience managing other engineering managers, with a track record of shipping impactful consumer products at scale

  • Strong technical foundation — you can review code, guide architectural decisions across multiple teams, and jump into the codebase when needed

  • Experience setting multi-team roadmaps and translating ambiguous, org-level problems into clear plans and shipped features alongside senior product, design, and data science partners

  • A demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain strong engineering managers and engineers — you care deeply about growing people's careers

  • Hands-on experience building and operating systems at scale in a production environment

  • Comfort thriving in fast-paced, ambiguous environments while keeping multiple teams focused across competing priorities

  • Forward-looking perspective on integrating AI and agentic coding into production engineering workflows

  • A love of music (listening, exploring, making — we're not picky about genre)

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience at a consumer tech or creator-platform company

  • Time spent at both larger organizations and smaller, high-growth startups

  • Familiarity with AI/ML-powered product development

  • Working knowledge of Modern web and native mobile technologies,, consumer media systems, or real-time systems

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S.

  • These are in-person roles based in Suno's New York City or Los Angeles office — please indicate your location preference when applying

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

The Commerce Platform is one of the most consequential systems at Suno - it's where every product decision about value becomes real. We're looking for a detail-obsessed engineer to own our commerce platform end-to-end: the billing, subscription, payment, and metering services that power how Suno makes money, and the surrounding systems that keep it correct - entitlements, involuntary churn recovery, fraud prevention, and accounting. You'll set the technical direction, be a key voice in how we think about the future of our revenue model, and build infrastructure that has to be exactly right at scale.


What You'll Do

  • Own Suno's commerce platform across web and mobile, including our vendor integrations and the core billing, subscription, payment, and metering services.

  • Build and evolve subscription and entitlement management - the source of truth for what every user has paid for and what they get access to.

  • Own payment methods and payment processing, expanding how users around the world can pay for Suno.

  • Recover revenue that would otherwise be lost: own involuntary churn (failed payments, dunning, recovery flows) and fraud prevention.

  • Build the financial correctness layer - accounting and reconciliation systems where the money has to be exactly right.

  • Lead the evolution of our billing architecture - including an in-progress migration to a modern ledger-based model - making it more maintainable and easier to reason about as the business grows.

  • Participate in product and strategy discussions about how Suno monetizes, bringing technical judgment to decisions that have direct revenue impact.

  • Build tools, systems, and interfaces that give the broader team more leverage to build products and perform analyses.

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally building systems where being wrong has immediate real-world consequences - payments, financial infrastructure, distributed systems, or similar.

  • A natural instinct to think about failure modes first: what happens if this event arrives twice, out of order, or not at all?

  • Strong product sense alongside technical depth - you care about what users experience, not just what the code does.

  • A high bar for correctness that you hold yourself and others to without being told.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • Experience with Stripe, RevenueCat, or payments/fraud systems is a plus.

  • A love for music is a huge plus.

Additional Notes: Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Location: This is an onsite role in our NYC or Cambridge, MA office.

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $220K – $280K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who is a true specialist in paid social performance marketing. You’ll manage our paid social campaigns end-to-end: platform partnerships, testing and measurement, driving web and app conversions at scale across markets.

This is a role for someone who has done this at real scale: you've managed paid social budgets of $30M+ annually, you understand attribution deeply, and you bring rigor, curiosity, and sharp analytical instincts to everything you touch. You should be comfortable digging into the data yourself — building your own analyses, spotting issues before anyone asks, and translating numbers into clear action. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

You're also a builder, not just an operator. When a workflow is slow or a test framework doesn't exist yet, you build it rather than waiting for someone else to. You think like a creator: better tests, sharper creative, smarter systems. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

We made a song about the role: https://suno.com/s/owdc28Zl5z3YqWbN

What You’ll Do

  • Own Paid Social channel performance globally: manage campaigns optimizing for web and app conversions, subscriptions, and growth KPIs across multiple geographies and markets. Evaluate and pilot new platforms and formats as they become relevant.

  • Drive full-funnel results: manage budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing to consistently hit CPA and ROAS targets at scale

  • Manage platform partnerships: own the relationship with paid social channel reps, including beta access, product roadmap input, billing, and spend reconciliation.

  • Own analysis and reporting: run proactive weekly performance analyses, using Excel and other tools to diagnose trends and surface opportunities. Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) to confirm spend is driving net new users, not just capturing demand that would have converted anyway.

  • Navigate app campaign complexity: own tracking setup (Conversions API), MMP integration (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust, etc.), and mobile attribution nuance across platforms

  • Build your own tools: when something is broken or needs improvement, build the fix yourself. Write the script, build the dashboard, design the smarter test framework. You do not wait for someone else to solve it, and you use your best judgement and expertise to make sure the analysis, strategy and execution drives excellent results.

  • Partner with creative & across the business: own all creative analysis and give structured feedback on ad creative, brief new concepts, and drive iteration based on performance data. Work with lifecycle/CRM, product, data science, and finance to align on audience strategy, budget, and measurement.

  • Own budget and forecasting: manage pacing across campaigns and markets, proactively reallocating spend to what’s working

  • Communicate with clarity: translate complex campaign data into sharp insights and recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders

Qualifications

  • 3+ years hands-on managing conversion-optimized paid social campaigns (must have specific paid social channel experience) with multi-million annual budget responsibility across major platforms

  • Strong grasp of web conversion campaigns — pixels, events, landing page performance, and full-funnel optimization

  • Experience running global campaigns across multiple geographies and markets

  • Experience with app campaign mechanics and mobile attribution (MMPs like Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust; SKAdNetwork, postbacks, etc.)

  • Sharp analytical skills: advanced in Excel, including pivot tables, with a track record of proactively running weekly and ad hoc analyses to diagnose performance and drive decisions — not just reporting on results, but getting ahead of them

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where channels, tools, and strategy evolve constantly

  • Nice to have: experience across a broad range of paid channels beyond the major social platforms (such as, X, Snapchat, Pinterest)

Additional Notes

  • Must be eligible to work in the US.

  • Must be willing to work 5 days/week in-office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for the target level for this role is $145,000 – $170,000 (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

If you’re the kind of engineering leader who’d rather ship than spectate, this one’s for you. You’ll lead a team building core product and platform capabilities for over 100 million creators — shaping system design, driving execution, and partnering with product, design, and data science to deliver experiences people actually love. This is a hands-on leadership role: you’ll set technical direction, grow your team, and keep things moving in a fast-paced, music-obsessed environment.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/H3GzRpa6Ze9A6DKr

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical direction for your team’s domain, driving architecture decisions and ensuring scalable, high-quality systems that serve millions of creators

  • Build, coach, and grow a team of engineers — hiring strong talent, running effective performance cycles, and creating a culture where people do their best work

  • Partner with product management, design, and data science to define roadmaps, scope projects, and ship features that move the needle

  • Navigate the full development lifecycle from ideation through launch, managing tradeoffs and removing blockers so your team stays focused and shipping

  • Champion engineering craft across your team — code quality, robust testing, and the right balance of rapid iteration with long-term maintainability

  • Contribute to Suno’s mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by delivering the tools and platform that turn imagination into music

What You’ll Need

Must-Haves

  • 5–7 years managing a software engineering team, with a track record of shipping impactful consumer products

  • Strong technical foundation — you can review code, guide architectural decisions, and jump into the codebase when needed

  • Experience translating ambiguous problems into clear plans and shipped features alongside product, design, and data science partners

  • A demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain strong engineers — you care deeply about growing people’s careers

  • Hands-on experience building and operating systems at scale in a production environment

  • Comfort thriving in fast-paced, ambiguous environments while keeping your team focused across multiple priorities

  • Forward-looking perspective on integrating AI and agentic coding into production engineering workflows

  • A love of music (listening, exploring, making — we’re not picky about genre)

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience at a consumer tech or creator-platform company

  • Time spent at both larger organizations and smaller, high-growth startups

  • Familiarity with AI/ML-powered product development

  • Working knowledge of Python, TypeScript, consumer media systems, or real-time systems

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S

  • This is an in-person role based in Suno’s Cambridge or NYC office

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

As a Senior Data Scientist on Content + Social, you'll build the analytical foundation for how people discover, listen to, share, and engage with music on Suno. You'll partner across three product areas — content experiences (listening, playlisting, and feed), social (shaping what community and interaction look like on Suno), and artists + creators (understanding what makes creators successful and how we amplify their work). This is a high-impact role where you'll set the strategy for how we measure and grow these interconnected experiences, working closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional partners on everything from strategy to execution.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/song/ca500252-9b76-442b-88bf-54befaff02ef?sh=LeSCpIrEXhGHEmS0

What You'll Do

  • Build comprehensive frameworks for understanding how users discover and engage with content and each other and design experiments to improve these experiences

  • Shape the analytical approach for our emerging social experiences, helping define what healthy social engagement looks like on a music platform and how to measure it

  • Develop deep understanding of creator and artist success which will drive our creator programs and incentives

  • Surface insights that connect content, social, and creator dynamics

  • Collaborate closely with product, business, and music functions

  • Contribute to building strong data foundations as part of our awesome data science team

  • 5+ years experience in data science roles, ideally with experience in content platforms, social products, or creator ecosystems

  • Excellent communication and collaboration

About the Role

Suno is looking to hire a communications leader to oversee our internal communications initiatives. Reporting to the Head of Communications, this role will build both functions from the ground up – guiding how we share information, navigate change, sustain our unique culture, and attract exceptional talent as we grow.

You’ll partner directly with our C-suite and executive leadership team to shape how Suno tells our story internally, and how we show the outside world what it’s like to work here. This is a rare opportunity to step into a foundational role at a category-defining AI company, where music, creativity and culture are core to the product itself.

Check out the Suno version of the role here: https://suno.com/s/NhWo8L6xJigF06aV

What You’ll Do

  • Define and lead Suno’s internal communications strategy, building both company-wide and tailored approaches for the C-suite and their organizations.

  • Act as a strategic partner to the executive team, helping leaders communicate with clarity, especially during moments of growth, change, and ambiguity.

  • Design and scale the moments that shape company culture, including all-hands meetings, offsites, and key internal touchpoints that foster creativity and trust.

  • Produce compelling, multi-channel storytelling that brings to life what it’s like to work at Suno across owned content, events, partnerships, earned media, and digital channels.

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We’re hiring Senior and Staff Product Designers to craft amazing experiences across platforms and help define the future of music. You will primarily drive end-to-end designs for our web app on desktop and mobile, but you’ll have a hand in other surfaces as well. We want to craft the world’s best app for creating and listening to music, from each major user flow to the smallest minutiae of the interaction design.

If you’re passionate about our mission and have a portfolio that remains user-centered while balancing innovation with intuitiveness, we’d love to hear from you.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/9eELmSnN4clvRUHW

What You’ll Do

  • Elevate the design of our web and mobile app experience across platforms because we love wearing a lot of hats.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and basically everyone else because you know the best ideas can come from anywhere.

  • Hold an incredibly high standard for quality and craft. You care about the little details (pixel-perfection, microinteractions, motion design) that add up to excellence.

  • Innovate. We aim to push the boundaries of UI and UX without losing sight of the user and what would be intuitive and engaging for them.

What You’ll Need

  • Experience crafting delightful consumer design. We’re flexible on experience level, but we do need to mutter “nice” to ourselves while scrolling through your portfolio.

  • A bias for action. You thrive as a self-starter in a fast-paced environment where you can wear many hats and bring your ideas to life.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You’re always learning and growing, and can help bring clarity to a fast-moving problem space with more questions than answers.

  • Expertise in Figma. Bonus points for skills in animated prototype and building/maintaining design system components.

  • A love of music (listening, exploring, making) is a huge plus.

 

Additional Notes

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working on-site 5 days a week in our NYC or LA offices.

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is: $215,000 - $324,000 (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno's product marketing function is at an inflection point. With a PMM team of two, we've been focused on only the highest-stakes launches. Now we're ready to invest in a senior product marketer who can own the casual creator experience end-to-end – how new users discover Suno, create their first song, and build early habits across web and mobile.

As a Senior PMM, you'll be the hands-on strategic lead for top-to-mid-funnel product marketing. You'll define and execute the strategy for app downloads, account creation, onboarding, first song, and early repeat usage, partnering closely with Product, UXR, Growth, and Brand. This is a high-impact IC role: you'll own major launches and user journey work directly, shape how millions of new users experience Suno, and raise the bar for how we do product marketing as a discipline.

This role is ideal for a seasoned consumer PMM who ships meaningful GTM strategies, loves being close to the work, and thrives in an ambiguous, rapidly-evolving environment.

Here's a song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/m8OAwnBeCMcrRF2m

What You'll Do

  • Define and own the casual creator growth & experiences strategy, including how Suno moves a user from discovery to signup to first song and early repeat use.

  • Develop a clear POV on which problems to solve first for new and casual users and why, grounded in user insights and business impact.

  • Stand up a repeatable GTM and user journey framework for consumer-facing features – including launch criteria, standard artifacts, shared success metrics, and playbooks that scale beyond you.

  • Lead GTM for key launches (e.g., onboarding revamp, core experience improvements, referral and community initiatives).

  • Build and execute a mobile-first strategy that drives app downloads, onboarding, and early engagement.

  • Partner with the Growth team to ideate, design, and run experiments that improve acquisition, activation, and early retention – bringing messaging expertise, user insight, and creative rigor to the experimentation roadmap.

  • Work with UXR and Data to map and optimize the new-user journey for core casual creator segments. Identify the highest-leverage touchpoints and ensure messaging is consistent across all.

  • Serve as a cross-functional partner and thought leader with Product, Design, UXR, Growth, and Brand. Influence roadmap priorities through strong user and market insights.

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years in consumer product marketing, ideally with strong exposure to technology, music, or creative tools.

  • Proven track record owning GTM end-to-end for meaningful consumer launches — from insight through execution and measurement.

  • Experience bringing mobile-centric consumer apps to market and growing stickiness / engagement over time.

  • Experience working closely with Product, UXR, and Growth in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments.

  • Deep experience with top-to-mid funnel (acquisition, onboarding, activation, early habit) for a consumer, UGC, or subscription product.

  • Exceptional storytelling and writing skills – able to turn complex product work into clear, compelling narratives, copy, and launch stories that resonate with new and casual users.

  • Analytical chops – comfortable setting success metrics, reading dashboards, and using data to refine strategy, journeys, and messaging.

  • Strong cross-functional influence – able to align Product, Design, UXR, Growth, Brand, and Creator/Artist partners around a single story and integrated plan without positional authority.

  • User-centric mindset – comfortable synthesizing UXR, data, and qualitative feedback into segment definitions, user journeys, and messaging.

  • Self-starter who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure where it doesn't exist.

  • Bias towards shipping and iterating vs. waiting for perfect information. Comfortable running experiments, learning fast, and implementing change.

  • Team-first, low-ego mindset – happy to roll up sleeves on everything from strategy to copy.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with UGC, creator ecosystems, or social/PLG products.

  • Experience on multi-platform products (web + mobile).

  • Prior work on subscription / monetization models or personalization / recommendation surfaces.

  • Deep personal passion for music – as a producer, player, or listener.

Additional Notes

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is an in-person role working at our NYC (Chelsea) office.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $175K – $210K + target equity + benefits

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

  • Be a go-to cross-functional legal partner for our music, business development and consumer partnership teams.

  • Structure, negotiate, and close a wide range of agreements including music and BD partnerships, developer agreements and general commercial transactions.

  • Help to build our commercial legal infrastructure, from contract templates to strategic playbooks, all in service of accelerating commercial momentum.

  • Use your experience as an experienced deal lawyer to our commercial advantage, helping our business partners make smarter and faster decisions.

What You’ll Need

  • JD and in good standing with an active US state bar membership.

  • At least 8+ years of experience, with substantial in-house and music or entertainment experience preferred.

  • Strong business acumen and ability to partner with business and technical teams.

  • An ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences

  • Hands-on attitude to tackle projects large and small, low-ego approach to working across the organization

  • Positive collaborative attitude, comfort with change and a fast pace, high level of integrity, and intellectual curiosity

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US

  • This role requires working on site in our New York office

If you care deeply about performance, polish, and building things that feel magical to use — and you want to do that in one of the most dynamic problem spaces in tech — this is the role for you.


Check out the Suno song we made about this role: https://suno.com/s/oEdmOtkZDLHCopSG

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build Suno’s iOS app across creation, discovery, playback, and social experiences

  • Create foundational abstractions and libraries for performant, highly interactive audio and animation

  • Collaborate closely with product and design to shape the feel, flow, and direction of the app

  • Optimize for performance, responsiveness, and delight — from frame rates to load times to micro-interactions

  • Instrument and monitor the app’s health, and iterate rapidly post-launch based on real user data

  • Set the technical direction for the iOS platform and define architectural patterns the team builds on

  • Mentor engineers and raise the bar for code quality, abstractions, and engineering culture

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years (Senior) or 7+ years (Staff) shipping production iOS apps

  • Advanced expertise in Swift — we use SwiftUI with UIKit where necessary

  • Deep experience building fluid, polished animations and translating design prototypes into robust, production-grade code

  • Strong sense for performance: you profile, benchmark, and fix, from UI thread contention to network efficiency

  • An obsession with great user experience — you care about the details that most engineers skip

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can scope work, make tradeoffs, and ship without a fully-defined spec

  • A collaborative spirit and strong communication — you work fluidly with designers, PMs, and backend teams

Strong Plusses

  • Experience working with audio playback systems, streaming pipelines, or real-time audio

  • Experience with social product features: feeds, follow graphs, notifications, publishing flows

  • Background designing or consuming mobile-first APIs in close collaboration with backend engineers

  • Track record building 0→1 consumer products at a fast-moving startup

  • Technical leadership or mentorship experience (especially important for Staff candidates)

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is a 5 day a week role in our LA, Venice Beach or Chelsea, NYC locations

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $200K – $300K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO with HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

You'll partner closely with other designers, product managers, and engineers to prototype, build, and refine user-facing features across our web and mobile platforms. We care deeply about craft, speed, and experimentation, and we're looking for someone who is equally excited about designing interfaces as they are about implementing them.

If you're passionate about creating exceptional consumer products and love working where design and engineering overlap, we'd love to hear from you.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/wocaJrca6E4RjJok

  • Take ideas end-to-end from conception to production. You drive creation whether it's collaboration in Figma, a novel proof of concept, or the code that turns concept into reality.

  • Strike a balance between proactive ownership and autonomy with a deeply collaborative spirit, working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and others.

  • Hold an incredibly high standard for quality and craft. You care about the little details (pixel-perfection, microinteractions, motion design) that add up to excellence.

  • Think in systems and patterns. You’ll help establish our design system to ensure consistency and quality across Product Design and Engineering.

  • Experiment rapidly with AI-powered workflows and creative tools that push the boundaries of what the team can accomplish together.

  • Mobile UI expertise. You craft delightful interfaces with iOS frameworks like SwiftUI and UIKit, and anything else that helps you design and build best-in-class mobile experiences.

  • A bias for action. You thrive as a self-starter in a fast-paced environment where you can wear many hats and bring your ideas to life.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You’re always learning and growing, and can help bring clarity to a fast-moving problem space with more questions than answers.

  • A love for music (listening, exploring, making) is a huge plus.

You'll partner closely with other designers, product managers, and engineers to prototype, build, and refine user-facing features across our web and mobile platforms. We care deeply about craft, speed, and experimentation, and we're looking for someone who is equally excited about designing interfaces as they are about implementing them.

If you're passionate about creating exceptional consumer products and love working where design and engineering overlap, we'd love to hear from you.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/wocaJrca6E4RjJok




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Take ideas end-to-end from conception to production. You drive creation whether it's collaboration in Figma, a novel proof of concept, or the code that turns concept into reality.

 - Strike a balance between proactive ownership and autonomy with a deeply collaborative spirit, working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and others.

 - Hold an incredibly high standard for quality and craft. You care about the little details (pixel-perfection, microinteractions, motion design) that add up to excellence.

 - Think in systems and patterns. You’ll help establish our design system to ensure consistency and quality across Product Design and Engineering.

 - Experiment rapidly with AI-powered workflows and creative tools that push the boundaries of what the team can accomplish together.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 5+ years (Senior) or 7+ years (Staff) of experience designing and building exceptional consumer products. Your portfolio showcases thoughtful design and shipped product experiences.

 - Mobile UI expertise. You craft delightful interfaces with iOS frameworks like SwiftUI and UIKit, and anything else that helps you design and build best-in-class mobile experiences.

 - A bias for action. You thrive as a self-starter in a fast-paced environment where you can wear many hats and bring your ideas to life.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. You’re always learning and growing, and can help bring clarity to a fast-moving problem space with more questions than answers.

 - A love for music (listening, exploring, making) is a huge plus.




ADDITIONAL NOTES

 - This is an in-person role working at our NYC or LA office.

 - Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

The Role

Growth Engineering owns the systems that turn interest in Suno into people who create, come back, and subscribe. This role sits at the seam between engineering and marketing: you'll build the tooling, landing pages, content infrastructure, and measurement that our marketing and growth efforts run on — and you'll have a direct, measurable hand in how Suno grows.

You'll partner closely with marketing, design, data, and the rest of growth eng to ship things like high-converting landing pages, a CMS the marketing team can drive themselves, attribution and event instrumentation we can trust, and SEO/AEO work that makes our highest-traffic pages fast and discoverable. You'll own projects end-to-end — from a marketer's rough ask to a shipped, instrumented, measurable result.

This is a builder role for someone who likes owning the full loop: ship it, measure it, learn from it, do it again.

Check out the Suno version of the role here! https://suno.com/s/HDng8LwKyV5c2xQK

What You'll Do

  • Build and optimize the infrastructure that enables marketers to run landing page A/B tests at scale to drive user activation and subscriptions from our campaigns.

  • Build and maintain the content infrastructure (CMS and supporting tooling) that lets marketing update the site and run campaigns without an engineer in the loop.

  • Own marketing measurement: pixels, event instrumentation, and attribution across web and mobile — so we can trust the data and act on it.

  • Build lifecycle and CRM journeys (push, email) triggered off real user behavior, in partnership with the marketing team.

  • Improve site performance and SEO/AEO on our highest-traffic pages.

  • Translate ambiguous, urgent marketing asks into a prioritized plan, ship fast, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and tradeoffs.

  • Use AI tooling systematically to move with speed and confidence across the whole stack.

What You'll Need

  • 3+ years of full-stack software engineering experience in a role within or adjacent to marketing.

  • Full-stack ability with a frontend lean — comfortable across FE and BE codebases without needing to be the deepest expert in any one layer.

  • Hands-on experience with one or more of: SEO/AEO/GEO, conversion-rate optimization (CRO), CMSes, and marketing attribution platforms.

  • Comfortable with data and SQL — you can reason about metrics, instrument what matters, and use data to decide what to build next.

  • Strong project ownership: you organize, prioritize, and drive your own work, and communicate progress proactively to non-technical stakeholders.

  • A bias toward shipping fast without sacrificing code quality or user experience.

  • Genuine interest in marketing technology — and in Suno's product and the future of music.

  • Experience applying AI tools beyond writing code.

Nice to Have

  • Experience instrumenting and reasoning about marketing funnels end-to-end (ad click → install/signup → activation → subscription).

  • Cross-platform experience (web + mobile) on growth or marketing work.

  • A track record of being the hands-on-keyboard owner of a user-facing, commercially meaningful project.

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $200-250K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Mobile Creation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

For most people, making music has always felt out of reach. Suno is changing that.

Millions of people are experiencing the joy of making music for the first time through Suno. We believe this is the beginning of a new category of consumer product, one where creating music becomes part of people’s everyday entertainment experience. Mobile will be the primary surface where this behavior takes shape.

We are seeking a Product Manager to lead the creation experience on mobile. This is a rare opportunity to shape how millions of people create music, helping make creativity feel effortless, expressive, and magical.

This role is ideal for a technical Product Manager who has significant experience building exceptional consumer mobile products at scale and wants to help build the next iconic app. You combine strong product intuition with deep empathy for users, a refined sense of taste, and a high bar for craft. You know how to move quickly, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and build products that delight millions of users.

Check out the Suno version of this role: https://suno.com/s/Y0WfEP7qALvaZanH

 

What You’ll Do

  • Reimagine music creation for mobile - Define the vision for how music is created, edited, explored, and shared on mobile. Invent new interaction patterns and workflows that make creating music feel intuitive, joyful, and accessible to everyone.

  • Build products people love - Lead the end-to-end development of consumer-facing features, from concept through launch and iteration. Create experiences that delight users while driving meaningful engagement and retention.

  • Shape the future of a new category - Identify emerging user behaviors and opportunities at the intersection of creativity, AI, and mobile consumer products. Translate those insights into ambitious product bets and clear roadmaps.

  • Champion craft and quality - Partner closely with Design and Engineering to deliver polished, high-quality experiences. Sweat the details while maintaining momentum and focus on outcomes.

  • Balance speed with scale - Make smart tradeoffs that enable rapid experimentation while building foundations that can support millions of users. Know when to move fast and when to invest for the long term.

  • Use data and intuition together - Combine product judgment, user research, and quantitative analysis to understand user needs and make informed decisions.

  • Collaborate across disciplines - Work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, User Research, and Product Marketing to bring innovative mobile experiences to market.

Who You Are

A product leader who is passionate about empowering creative expression:

  • 6+ years of experience in product management or related roles, with significant ownership of consumer mobile products

  • Proven track record of shipping successful mobile experiences at scale

  • Deep understanding of mobile product design, interaction patterns, and user behavior

  • Strong product taste and a demonstrated ability to make high-quality product decisions

  • Excited by ambiguity and energized by building entirely new product categories

  • Excellent communicator who can align teams around a clear vision

  • Strong analytical skills paired with exceptional user empathy

  • Passionate about consumer technology and building products that become part of people’s daily lives

  • Excited about the future of creation, music, and AI

  • Strong technical foundation, with a background in computer science, engineering, or a related field

Additional Notes

  • You must be authorized to work in the United States.

  • You must be willing to work 5 days per week at our Venice Beach office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $250K – $330K + target equity

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re seeking a highly creative, multidisciplinary Senior Designer, Creative Studio to join Suno’s Brand & Creative Team. You’ll work at the intersection of brand, culture, and product—helping translate Suno’s creative vision into expressive, high-impact design across platforms and formats.

This role plays a key part in evolving Suno’s brand across marketing campaigns, artist partnerships, in-product brand moments, and culture-defining activations. You’ll help shape how Suno shows up visually at moments that matter—from product launches and campaigns to artist collaborations and creative brand expressions.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with creative leadership, designers, writers, motion artists, project managers, product designers, and cross-functional teams to concept, design, and execute work that evolves Suno’s brand.

This role is ideal for a designer who delivers innovative, standout work with precision—evolving the brand through bold ideas that are executed confidently and consistently within Suno’s creative direction.

Check out the Suno version of this role here! https://suno.com/s/p71hcfuWMLRPqgt8

What You’ll Do

  • Design and execute multidisciplinary creative work that evolves Suno’s brand across campaigns, artist partnerships, in-product moments, and brand activations.

  • Create innovative, high-impact design while maintaining precision and consistency within Suno’s creative direction and brand guidelines.

  • Support artist collaborations and partnerships, developing visuals and assets that authentically reflect both the artist’s voice and Suno’s identity.

  • Contribute to product launches and in-product brand moments, partnering with the Design Director and cross-functional teams (product design, GTM, Growth) to ensure a cohesive visual experience.

  • Translate ideas into polished, production-ready assets across digital, social, print, and motion formats.

  • Iterate quickly and thoughtfully in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, embracing feedback to evolve ideas and elevate the work.

  • Design with a global audience and end-to-end user experience in mind.

  • Maintain a high bar for craft and attention to detail across every execution.

  • Collaborate closely with designers, writers, motion artists, and cross-functional partners to bring great work to life.

What You’ll Need

  • 8+ years of experience as a graphic designer working across multiple disciplines (brand, marketing, digital, social, campaigns, content, etc.).

  • A strong portfolio showcasing innovative thinking and executional excellence across a range of formats and platforms.

  • A multidisciplinary designer. You have experience working across brand, marketing, campaigns, content, and digital surfaces, and you adapt your craft fluidly across formats. Motion experience is a strong bonus.

  • Craft-obsessed. You can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom all the way in to the smallest details—from typography and layout to motion, spacing, and final polish. You know great work is built through care, precision, and attention to detail.

  • Collaborative to your core. You love working closely with designers, motion artists, writers, product teams, and partners—embracing feedback and shaping ideas together to create work that’s both inspiring and practical.

  • A proactive builder. You thrive in ambiguity, spot opportunities early, and bring structure to creative chaos—proposing ideas, improving systems, and pushing work forward.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment. You can juggle multiple projects, iterate quickly and thoughtfully, and maintain a high bar for quality under changing timelines.

  • Brand-forward and user-aware. You think globally, care about the end-to-end user experience, and design with both consistency and cultural relevance in mind.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma; motion design skills (After Effects, animated prototypes, etc.) are a strong bonus.

  • Passionate about music and culture. You’re excited by artists, creative expression, and emerging technology—and motivated by shaping how people experience music.

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is an in-person role working at our NYC offices.

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $150-175K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Check out the Suno version of this role here! https://suno.com/s/p71hcfuWMLRPqgt8
