jobs.title: Creator Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

If you’ve ever wanted to build something from scratch and own it end-to-end, this is it. Suno is looking for a Creator Program Manager to own our ambassador program — sourcing, onboarding, and scaling a network of creator advocates who drive Suno’s organic growth. You’ll be joining our Influencer Marketing team at a moment when we need to move fast, be scrappy and prioritize scale. The program needs more pipeline, more quality creators, and more output, and you’re the person who’s going to make that happen. You’ll partner closely with Growth and Influencer Marketing to build the systems, relationships, and campaigns that turn great creators into great Suno ambassadors.

Here's a song we made about the role: https://suno.com/s/z03E89izj9mSWs8d

What You'll Do

  • Source and onboard new ambassadors at scale — building and owning the full pipeline from prospecting to contracting to activation

  • Design and manage systems and processes to support 1,000+ active ambassadors, including 3rd party vendor relationships and tooling that makes the program run efficiently

  • Run campaigns end-to-end, from brief to execution, testing creative formats and doubling down on what works

  • Track performance and own data reporting — turning ambassador output into clear signals that inform program strategy

  • Help make creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone — by giving creators the tools, support, and opportunities to share what they make with Suno with the world

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of experience in ambassador programs, influencer marketing, or creator partnerships

  • Proven track record sourcing and scaling creator networks — you know how to find great creators and how to keep them

  • Deep understanding of UGC, creative brief writing, and influencer contracting

  • Scrappy, self-starter energy — you don’t wait for perfect conditions, you build the conditions

  • Highly autonomous with the ability to manage a complex, high-volume program independently

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving environments — you adapt before most people notice things changed

  • Proficient in AI tools including Claude

  • Familiarity with ambassador management and tracking tools – able to manage a large group of ambassadors at large scale

  • Experience with or genuine enthusiasm for Suno

  • Strong intuition for UGC and consumer culture — you know what’s going to resonate before the data does

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

 

Compensation

The annual base salary range is: $110,000 – $170,000 (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno is growing fast, and paid social creative is a major driver of that growth. The right person for this role takes Suno's brand identity and pushes it into performance creative that earns attention and converts – work that drives growth and brings the excitement of using Suno to everyone who sees it.

As Graphic Designer on the Performance Marketing team, you'll own the branded paid social creative pipeline: conceiving, producing, and iterating on work across branded static formats. You'll work closely with the performance marketing team, treating data and channel insights as creative inputs rather than afterthoughts. Over time, you'll help build the workflows and systems that let us scale without losing what makes Suno's creative distinctive. As the team grows, there's a path to managing other creative contributors.

Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax

What You'll Do

  • Translate Suno's brand identity and creative DNA into paid social creative that drives growth across paid channels (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)

  • Own the full branded creative pipeline – concepting, producing, and iterating on branded static assets

  • Build and maintain a creative roadmap: what to make, what to test, what to push further, and what to move on from

  • Partner with the performance marketing team to use data and channel feedback as creative inputs, not just outputs

  • Use AI tools to extend creative output beyond what's manually possible – and help build the processes and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on-brand and up to Suno's standards

  • Develop workflows and production processes that scale creative output without diluting brand quality

  • Help shape how the next generation of creators discovers Suno – the creative you make is often their first impression



What You'll Need

  • 4-6 years in performance creative, paid social design, or growth-focused creative at a consumer tech, DTC, or growth-stage company

  • Expert graphic design skills: strong static design fundamentals and a sharp eye for details and consumer psychology

  • Portfolio of paid social work that demonstrates both craft and a performance orientation

  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, etc.

  • Fluency in what makes paid social creative work: hooks, formats, platform conventions, and what drives meaningful iteration

  • Ability to internalize a brand's visual identity and push it into new formats without losing what makes it distinctive

Compensation

$75 - $90 per hour

Additional Notes

20-40 hours per week

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. About the Role

If you’ve spent your career building world-class support organizations and you’re itching to rebuild one from the ground up — AI-first, data-driven, and at real scale — this is the role. As Sr. Manager of Customer Experience at Suno, you’ll own our customer support function end-to-end: setting and managing SLAs, running a lean P&L, and ensuring every user who needs help gets a high-quality experience. You’ll lead a team of 6–8 support ICs and partner closely with Trust & Safety, Product, Billing, Legal, and Policy to solve some of our hardest customer-facing problems. You’ll report to the Sr. Director of Customer Experience & Safety.

What You’ll Do

  • Define, track, and manage to SLAs across all support channels — using data to surface trends, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement in resolution time and quality.

  • Own the support P&L, managing costs while scaling capacity intelligently as the product and user base grow.

  • Design the right support experience for each problem type — deciding when a user needs a human, an AI agent, a help article, or a proactive fix upstream in the product.

  • Build and iterate on operational processes that make the team faster, more consistent, and less reliant on manual effort — including launching new support channels.

  • Lead and develop a team of 6–8 support ICs, setting clear expectations, coaching on quality, and building a culture that’s as data-minded as it is customer-obsessed.

  • Partner with Product, T&S, Billing, and Legal to close the loop between support signals and product decisions — helping Suno build toward a future where creative fulfillment is a daily reality for everyone.

What You’ll Need

Must-Haves

  • 7–9 years of experience in support leadership, with a track record of building and managing high-performing teams.

  • Background in consumer technology — you understand what it means to support a large, diverse user base with high expectations and low tolerance for friction.

  • Experience building or scaling multi-channel support operations (email, chat, in-app, etc.).

  • A genuinely data-driven operating style — you set goals in metrics, track them rigorously, and use data to make decisions, not just report outcomes.

  • Experience managing a support P&L or cost-per-ticket model.

  • Strong process instincts — you document, systematize, and build for repeatability.

  • Experience with AI-native or AI-assisted support tooling (deflection flows, chatbots, copilots for agents, or similar).

Nice-to-Haves

  • Hands-on experience building with LLM-powered support tools — prompt design, workflow automation, or agent evaluation.

  • Familiarity with Trust & Safety-adjacent support workflows.

  • Background in the music industry or a music-adjacent platforms, whether working with artists, labels, or music creators, with the ability to speak fluently about music production, audio editing, and/or the creative process

  • Experience scaling a support org through rapid company or product growth.

  • Hands-on work operating tiered support models across distinct customer segments, including free and paid subscribers, enterprise or API clients, and high-profile creators or artists, with a strong sense of when and how to escalate and how to calibrate the experience for each tier

  • Background supporting billing, fraud, or identity-related user issues.

  • Experience running community or self-serve support programs (help centers, forums, FAQs).

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno’s company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Willingness to travel (up to 10%) to collaborate with team members across Suno office locations.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno is scaling fast, and the accounting function is being built from the ground up. As our Director of Accounting, you'll be the Controller's right hand and one of the first hires on the accounting team, owning the monthly close, consolidations, and the general ledger while standing up the controls, systems, and technical accounting foundation a company at our stage needs to grow into a best-in-class finance organization. You'll lead us through our first-year audit, build toward IPO readiness, and bring a measured, meaningful approach to AI that unlocks the efficiency and capability a modern accounting team should have. You'll partner closely with FP&A, People, Legal, and the broader business, and you'll set the standard for how we operate, document, and automate as we scale. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to do the work today and grow into a leader as the team grows around them.

Check out the Suno version of this role here! https://suno.com/s/I3tlv9gdKZ9YaCDN

What You'll Do

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close and consolidation process, driving toward a faster, cleaner, and well-documented cycle.

  • Build and maintain the general ledger, chart of accounts, and accounting policies that scale with a high-growth, global business.

  • Research and conclude on technical accounting and document positions in clear, audit-ready memos.

  • Lead the company through its first-year financial statement audit and build toward the controls and rigor required for IPO readiness.

  • Design the controls, systems, and AI-enabled automation that make accounting meaningfully more efficient, adopting new tools with measured judgment and the right guardrails, the way a best-in-class team should.

  • Lay the foundation for a best-in-class accounting team, across people, process, and systems, that helps make creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 8-10 years of progressive accounting experience, including a mix of Big 4 public accounting and high-growth industry roles.

  • CPA with deep technical US GAAP expertise.

  • Proven ownership of the close and consolidation process, ideally across multiple entities or currencies.

  • Experience leading external financial statement audits, first-year audit experience is ideal.

  • Experience in consumer tech, SaaS, or other high-volume revenue environments.

  • Hands-on experience implementing accounting systems, automation, and internal controls, including a demonstrated, measured use of AI to unlock efficiency.

  • A builder's mindset, comfortable doing the work yourself today while designing the processes and team to scale tomorrow.

Nice-to-Haves

• Familiarity with music royalties or content / IP-related accounting.

• IPO readiness, SOX, global / multi-entity, or M&A / integration experience.

• Demonstrated capability building AI-enabled accounting workflows a real plus.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • Willingness to travel (up to 10%) to collaborate with team members across Suno office locations.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

• Company Equity Package

• 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

• Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

• 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

• 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

• Creative Education Stipend

• Generous Commuter Allowance

• In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is $210,000 – $260,000.

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno is building the future of music creation, and our People team is at the heart of how we grow, support, and develop our team. We’re looking for a People Operations Manager to join us as a key individual contributor on the People team, reporting directly to the Director of People Rewards, Operations & Systems. This role is the operational backbone of our People function, owning the full employee lifecycle, managing our HRIS and people data infrastructure, and driving the systems and workflow improvements that keep Suno running smoothly at scale. If you love building clean processes, thrive on figuring out how to make things work better, and want to do it all at one of the most exciting companies in AI, this is the role for you.

Check out our Suno version of the job here!

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full employee lifecycle end to end — onboarding, job and compensation changes, leave administration, and offboarding — setting the standards and documentation the rest of the company follows. Serve as a key operational partner to Talent, IT, and Office Management.

  • Own and evolve Suno’s HRIS, leading system migrations, maintaining accurate employee records, and ensuring ongoing compliance with documentation requirements.

  • Build and maintain employee-facing information and resource pages, keeping content current and easy to navigate as the company grows.

  • Partner closely with Finance and People leadership on payroll, owning the People-side inputs — new hires, job and pay changes, terminations, and deductions — and reconciling them each cycle for timely, accurate execution.

  • Own immigration case management for employees, coordinating with external counsel and internal stakeholders from initiation through approval.

  • Identify and drive system and workflow efficiencies across People Operations by proactively finding opportunities to automate, streamline, and scale processes through AI and modern tooling.

  • Lead People programs and cross-functional projects end to end, from engagement initiatives to policy updates and beyond, improving the overall employee experience.

  • Serve as the owner of headcount and org data, partnering with Talent, Finance, and leadership to keep workforce information accurate and decision-ready as talent plans evolve.

  • Act as the subject-matter expert and escalation point for People Operations across the company, raising the bar on how the team operates and mentoring teammates as the function grows.

What You’ll Need

  • 6+ years of experience in People Operations, HR, or a related generalist role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company

  • Strong analytical skills and deep hands-on experience managing HRIS and people systems (e.g., Rippling, ADP, BambooHR, Workday, or similar), including migrations and data integrity

  • Experience leveraging AI tools and building automated workflows to improve operational efficiency on the People team

  • Deep working knowledge of US employment compliance, including record-keeping, I-9 requirements, and state/federal regulations

  • Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail; you manage many concurrent workstreams without losing the thread

  • High comfort with ambiguity and troubleshooting; you can navigate shifting priorities and figure things out when there’s no playbook

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build trust across teams and work cross-functionally with ease

  • Hands-on experience with payroll processing and the ability to partner effectively with Finance and the team or vendor running it; full ownership of payroll is not required, but fluency in how it works is

  • Experience managing immigration processes, including coordinating with external counsel, tracking case statuses, and managing documentation for visa and work authorization needs

  • Experience administering leave management programs, including medical, parental, and other statutory leaves, with working knowledge of applicable federal and state leave laws

  • A track record of operating autonomously and influencing without authority — you’ve owned an operational domain end to end and driven change across teams without direct reports

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role is based in Cambridge, MA and requires being in office 5 days per week.


Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Suno is building the future of music creation, and as we scale, we’re building out a world-class People function to match. We’re looking for a Senior Benefits & Compensation Manager to join the People team as a key individual contributor, reporting to the Director of People Rewards, Operations & Systems. In this role, you’ll own two of the most consequential areas of the employee experience — compensation and benefits, designing and managing programs that are equitable, competitive, and distinctly Suno. You’ll bring deep expertise, creative thinking, and a sharp eye for detail to everything from open enrollment to compensation cycle execution, all while keeping the employee experience front and center.

Check out our Suno version of the job here!

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end compensation cycle execution, including data maintenance and updates, annual cycle changes, market benchmarking, and championing pay equity across the organization.

  • Lead and manage Suno’s benefits programs, including open enrollment, new hire and mid-year changes, broker relationship management, and benefit plan administration and renewals.

  • Manage benefit audits and required filings (e.g., ACA, 5500), handling them directly or in close partnership with brokers and external advisors to ensure accuracy and timeliness.

  • Design and deliver candidate and employee-facing communications, resources, and training for compensation and benefits programs, translating complex information into clear, accessible content with an employee experience lens.

  • Partner closely with Finance, the Talent team, and HR Business Partners to support headcount planning, leveling, performance management cycles, and compensation-related decision-making.

  • Support talent planning and management processes as the scope evolves, including leveling frameworks, performance management resources, and related compensation infrastructure.


What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of experience in compensation and benefits, with demonstrated specialist-level depth in both areas, ideally in a high-growth tech environment

  • Deep knowledge of US benefits plan design, administration, and compliance, including open enrollment, ACA, COBRA, ERISA, and required filings, with creative, forward-thinking approaches to benefits solutions

  • Strong understanding of compensation practices, including market benchmarking, pay equity analysis, leveling, and managing compensation cycles and processes end to end

  • Proven ability to design employee communications, resources, and trainings that make complex topics clear and engaging, with a strong employee experience lens

  • Exceptional attention to detail; you catch what others miss and take pride in accuracy across data, filings, and program execution

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with experience partnering with Finance, Talent, HR Business Partners, Internal Comms on shared programs and priorities

  • UX-oriented; you care how policies feel, not just how they function

  • Comfortable balancing compliance rigor with startup speed

  • Hands-on with AI tools and motivated to embed automation into daily workflows

  • Experience working with multiple external vendors and knowing how to manage those relationships and agreements effectively

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role is based in NYC or Cambridge, MA and requires being in office 5 days per week.


Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. About the Role

AI is changing how software gets built and how companies run and we intend to be at the front of it. We're hiring a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to build the systems that let every team at Suno move fast and scale with our rapid growth. This is greenfield work with real ownership, and you'll help shape how Suno adopts AI.

We're hiring across two AI Engineering teams. One, AI Leverage, empowers engineers and other teams to move faster at scale with agentic tools. The other, AI Ops, unlocks operations areas like support, legal, finance, and beyond with workflows and agents.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build AI-powered internal systems that let everyone at Suno, from engineers to recruiters, do more with AI

  • Own the underlying infrastructure that keeps our AI tooling running in production: reliable, observable, cost-effective, and flexible

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to understand their workflows, surface the right problems to solve, and prioritize what gets built next

  • Champion best practices for agentic coding and operations, and help teams adopt them across the company

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • You bring 5–7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience

  • You’ve designed, built, and shipped AI-based tools that go well beyond using a coding assistant, and you’re fluent in concepts like agent loops, memory, MCP, and evaluations

  • You have a track record of shipping tooling or systems that support engineering or internal business operations

Finding joy through being creative is inherent in human nature. The Consumer Create team is building experiences to enable users to entertain themselves through their own creativity. We are hiring a data scientist to be a thought leader on this new team. In this high-impact role, you will collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Design to set the product strategy and roadmap for how we grow and measure creative engagement on our mobile app.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with product and engineering to shape the roadmap for Mobile Consumer Create, from early ideation through launch

  • Design and run experiments end-to-end that test new ways to make creation on mobile more fun and rewarding

  • Build analyses that surface user behavior patterns and inform how we think about and build for our consumers. Identify the "magic moments" that keep people creating, and the product changes that lead to more of them

  • Establish the metrics and frameworks the team uses to define and measure success

  • Contribute to building strong data foundations as part of our awesome data science team

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 6–8+ years of experience in data science in consumer tech and mobile apps

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and statistical modeling

  • Experience running experiments end-to-end, from design through analysis to shipping decision

  • A user-centric, product-first mindset

  • Excellent communication and collaboration

  • A self-starter mentality with the ability to thrive in ambiguity, eagerness to wear multiple hats, and passion for continuous learning

  • Proficiency with and excitement about using and building AI tools

As a data Scientist on Growth Product, you'll own the analytics for the early-life user journey: everything from the moment someone lands on Suno through their first sessions, first songs, and first reasons to come back. A user's first few experiences are some of the most important inflection points in their lifecycle, and getting them right is one of the highest-leverage problems at Suno. You'll lead data science support on the Growth Activation team, working very closely with product, engineering, and design.

What You'll Do

  • Own the analytics for how new users activate and form habits on Suno, from signup and onboarding through everything that happens in their first week on Suno

  • Design experiments that improve the early-life journey, from push notifications and lifecycle messaging to product surfaces like Hooks, Create, and net-new experiences

  • Sit on a centralized data science team but serve as the lead DS on Growth Activate, collaborating closely with product, engineering, and design

  • Advance our mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by turning first visits into daily creative habits

  • Contribute to building strong data foundations as part of our awesome data science team

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 5-7+ years in data science or product analytics roles, ideally on consumer products

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and statistical modeling

  • Deep experimentation experience grounded in statistical rigor: designing and running experiments end to end, deriving clear insights, and making strategic recommendations

  • A broad data science toolkit and the judgment to pick the right tool for the right question, all ultimately in service of making thoughtful product decisions

  • A self-starter mentality with an ownership mindset: you thrive in ambiguity, wear multiple hats, and never stop learning

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration: you work closely with product, eng, and design, and influence stakeholders and teams through data insights

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience at a fast-growing consumer app, or a startup that scaled through strong product-led growth

  • A love of music or creative tools

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is the role that decides what that creative is and why: the strategist who turns audience insight into the concepts everyone else executes. You’ll lead the audience and market research that uncovers new angles, pain points, and use cases, then turn them into a steady backlog of concepts and briefs that designers and editors run with across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

This is a high-ownership role with real strategic latitude. You won’t be handed a brief and told to fill it, you’ll write the briefs. You’ll bring your own read on which audiences are worth chasing, what story wins them, and which formats to test, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your concepts quickly enough to act on them.

If you think in audiences and angles, read hook rate and hold rate as fluently as you spot a fresh one, and want your concepts running in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead deep audience and market research to uncover new personas, pain points, and use cases worth targeting.

  • Turn that research into a steady backlog of net-new ad concepts, each with a clear rationale for why it should win.

  • Write sharp creative briefs that give designers, editors, and producers a clear direction to execute against.

  • Develop angles, hooks, and messaging built around how people actually behave on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

  • Define what to test next and why, isolating variables so every result teaches us something.

  • Keep a deep bench of fresh ideas in flight to stay ahead of creative fatigue, so no single winner carries the account too long.

  • Partner with performance marketing managers to turn account needs into concrete creative direction.

  • Read performance signals and feed them back into sharper concepts, as bandwidth allows.

What You’ll Need

Must-Haves

  • Proven experience as a creative strategist in a high-volume, high-velocity performance creative environment.

  • A strong track record of paid social creative for live Meta and/or TikTok campaigns, with results you can speak to.

  • A real grasp of direct-response creative: audiences, angles, hooks, and why an ad wins or loses, not just how it looks.

  • Deep fluency in audience and market research, and the instinct to turn it into non-obvious angles.

  • The range to own strategy end to end and the scrappiness to write the hooks and do the research yourself. No task is beneath you.

  • A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

  • Fluency in Motion (or a comparable creative analytics tool) to read what’s driving performance and act on it.

  • Comfort reading metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and turning them into the next round of concepts.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

  • Comfort folding AI tools into research and ideation to move faster.

  • A love of music and an eye for culture.

Compensation

This is a contract role paying $80 to $120 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is the role that decides what that creative is and why: the strategist who turns audience insight into the concepts everyone else executes. You’ll lead the audience and market research that uncovers new angles, pain points, and use cases, then turn them into a steady backlog of concepts and briefs that designers and editors run with across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

This is a high-ownership role with real strategic latitude. You won’t be handed a brief and told to fill it, you’ll write the briefs. You’ll bring your own read on which audiences are worth chasing, what story wins them, and which formats to test, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your concepts quickly enough to act on them.

If you think in audiences and angles, read hook rate and hold rate as fluently as you spot a fresh one, and want your concepts running in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead deep audience and market research to uncover new personas, pain points, and use cases worth targeting.

 - Turn that research into a steady backlog of net-new ad concepts, each with a clear rationale for why it should win.

 - Write sharp creative briefs that give designers, editors, and producers a clear direction to execute against.

 - Develop angles, hooks, and messaging built around how people actually behave on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

 - Define what to test next and why, isolating variables so every result teaches us something.

 - Keep a deep bench of fresh ideas in flight to stay ahead of creative fatigue, so no single winner carries the account too long.

 - Partner with performance marketing managers to turn account needs into concrete creative direction.

 - Read performance signals and feed them back into sharper concepts, as bandwidth allows.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

Must-Haves

 - Proven experience as a creative strategist in a high-volume, high-velocity performance creative environment.

 - A strong track record of paid social creative for live Meta and/or TikTok campaigns, with results you can speak to.

 - A real grasp of direct-response creative: audiences, angles, hooks, and why an ad wins or loses, not just how it looks.

 - Deep fluency in audience and market research, and the instinct to turn it into non-obvious angles.

 - The range to own strategy end to end and the scrappiness to write the hooks and do the research yourself. No task is beneath you.

 - A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

 - Fluency in Motion (or a comparable creative analytics tool) to read what’s driving performance and act on it.

 - Comfort reading metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and turning them into the next round of concepts.

Nice-to-Haves

 - Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

 - Comfort folding AI tools into research and ideation to move faster.

 - A love of music and an eye for culture.



Compensation

This is a contract role paying $80 to $120 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead of ML Data Operations to build and lead a new function at Suno. This team owns how we source and develop the data that powers our models. You’ll work closely with Research and Product to understand what's needed and figuring out how to deliver it, whether through external partners, in-product collection, or both. You’ll also build this function from the ground up so expect real ownership and real ambiguity in equal measure!

 
 

What You'll Do

  • Source, evaluate, and manage relationships with external data labeling vendors, from initial scoping through contracts, quality oversight, and ongoing performance

  • Partner with ML researchers to understand data requirements and develop concrete plans to meet them

  • Identify opportunities to improve how Suno collects data with product and engineering

  • Build and lead the team, systems, and processes that make data sourcing a reliable, repeatable capability

  • Contribute to a data-driven model development culture as part of a close-knit team of researchers, engineers, and product builders

  • Support our mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone

 
 

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

  • 6–8+ years of experience in ML data operations, training data, or data labeling programs with direct experience managing external labeling vendors, building internal labeling systems, or both

  • Demonstrated leadership at a director or equivalent level, with a track record of building teams or functions that didn't previously exist

  • Comfort and excitement with operating with a high degree of autonomy where the path isn't fully defined

  • Strong cross-functional instincts across Research, Product, and Engineering

Nice-to-Haves

  • Background at a foundational model company or data labeling organization

  • Experience influencing how product features are designed with training data collection in mind

  • Familiarity with music, audio, or creative AI

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

 

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

 

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Artificial intelligence is transforming every creative field. At Suno, we are building one of the world's leading generative music models, enabling millions of people to become musicians for the first time.

We are hiring the first Product Manager dedicated to our Research organization.

In this role, you will partner closely with world-class machine learning engineers to identify the highest-impact opportunities for improving our models. By combining user understanding with rigorous evaluation and product judgment, you will help researchers focus on the problems whose solutions have the greatest impact on our business.

This is a rare opportunity to bring product judgment into the model development process: helping ensure our research efforts are grounded in real user needs, evaluated thoughtfully, and translated into meaningful improvements in what people can create with Suno.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/Y0WfEP7qALvaZanH

What You'll Do

  • Define what “good” means — Own the evaluation frameworks and quality metrics for Suno’s foundational music model: what we measure, why it matters, and how we know the model is improving.

  • Connect creator needs to model capabilities — Deeply understand how people create with Suno, identify where the model helps or falls short, and translate those insights into research problems the team can act on.

  • Bridge product and research — Partner with user-facing PMs, engineers, and data scientists to understand real-world model behavior and turn those learnings into better evaluations, clearer priorities, and more useful capabilities.

  • Shape model priorities in partnership with Research — Bring user insight, data, and business context into roadmap discussions, helping the team make thoughtful tradeoffs when research opportunities and product needs compete.

  • Bring new models and capabilities to market — Work with Research, Product, and Product Marketing to launch model improvements in a way users can understand, adopt, and get value from.

  • Go deep technically — Run experiments, dig into model behavior, and work in the details alongside researchers and data scientists.

Who You Are

A product leader with a deep passion and curiosity for AI:

  • 6+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience building highly technical products

  • Experience partnering closely with machine learning researchers, model training teams, or AI evaluation systems

  • Strong technical intuition and the ability to engage deeply with complex machine learning concepts

  • A strong technical foundation, ideally with a background in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related field

  • Exceptional product judgment and the ability to bring clarity and structure to ambiguous, research-driven problems

  • A first-principles thinker who is naturally curious about how frontier AI models work and how they can be improved

  • Operates with urgency and thrives in fast-moving, iterative environments

  • Excited by the intersection of AI, creativity, and music

Bonus Points

  • Experience working at a frontier AI lab or on a foundation model team

  • Experience designing or building AI evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or human evaluation systems

  • Experience working with large-scale datasets, data quality, or annotation pipeline.

Additional Notes

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy.

  • Must be willing to travel once per quarter for larger team meetings.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation:

$250K – $330K base salary (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who is a true specialist in paid social performance marketing. You’ll manage our paid social campaigns end-to-end: platform partnerships, testing and measurement, driving web and app conversions at scale across markets.

This is a role for someone who has done this at real scale: you've managed paid social budgets of $30M+ annually, you understand attribution deeply, and you bring rigor, curiosity, and sharp analytical instincts to everything you touch. You should be comfortable digging into the data yourself — building your own analyses, spotting issues before anyone asks, and translating numbers into clear action. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

You're also a builder, not just an operator. When a workflow is slow or a test framework doesn't exist yet, you build it rather than waiting for someone else to. You think like a creator: better tests, sharper creative, smarter systems. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

We made a song about the role: https://suno.com/s/owdc28Zl5z3YqWbN

What You’ll Do

  • Own Paid Social channel performance globally: manage campaigns optimizing for web and app conversions, subscriptions, and growth KPIs across multiple geographies and markets. Evaluate and pilot new platforms and formats as they become relevant.

  • Drive full-funnel results: manage budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing to consistently hit CPA and ROAS targets at scale

  • Manage platform partnerships: own the relationship with paid social channel reps, including beta access, product roadmap input, billing, and spend reconciliation.

  • Own analysis and reporting: run proactive weekly performance analyses, using Excel and other tools to diagnose trends and surface opportunities. Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) to confirm spend is driving net new users, not just capturing demand that would have converted anyway.

  • Navigate app campaign complexity: own tracking setup (Conversions API), MMP integration (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust, etc.), and mobile attribution nuance across platforms

  • Build your own tools: when something is broken or needs improvement, build the fix yourself. Write the script, build the dashboard, design the smarter test framework. You do not wait for someone else to solve it, and you use your best judgement and expertise to make sure the analysis, strategy and execution drives excellent results.

  • Partner with creative & across the business: own all creative analysis and give structured feedback on ad creative, brief new concepts, and drive iteration based on performance data. Work with lifecycle/CRM, product, data science, and finance to align on audience strategy, budget, and measurement.

  • Own budget and forecasting: manage pacing across campaigns and markets, proactively reallocating spend to what’s working

  • Communicate with clarity: translate complex campaign data into sharp insights and recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders

Qualifications

  • 3+ years hands-on managing conversion-optimized paid social campaigns (must have specific paid social channel experience) with multi-million annual budget responsibility across major platforms

  • Strong grasp of web conversion campaigns — pixels, events, landing page performance, and full-funnel optimization

  • Experience running global campaigns across multiple geographies and markets

  • Experience with app campaign mechanics and mobile attribution (MMPs like Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust; SKAdNetwork, postbacks, etc.)

  • Sharp analytical skills: advanced in Excel, including pivot tables, with a track record of proactively running weekly and ad hoc analyses to diagnose performance and drive decisions — not just reporting on results, but getting ahead of them

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where channels, tools, and strategy evolve constantly

  • Nice to have: experience across a broad range of paid channels beyond the major social platforms (such as, X, Snapchat, Pinterest)

Additional Notes

  • Must be eligible to work in the US.

  • Must be willing to work 5 days/week in-office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

Base salary: $145,000 – $170,000 (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances.  - Own analysis and reporting: run proactive weekly performance analyses, using Excel and other tools to diagnose trends and surface opportunities. Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) to confirm spend is driving net new users, not just capturing demand that would have converted anyway.

 - Navigate app campaign complexity: own tracking setup (Conversions API), MMP integration (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust, etc.), and mobile attribution nuance across platforms

 - Build your own tools: when something is broken or needs improvement, build the fix yourself. Write the script, build the dashboard, design the smarter test framework. You do not wait for someone else to solve it, and you use your best judgement and expertise to make sure the analysis, strategy and execution drives excellent results.

 - Partner with creative & across the business: own all creative analysis and give structured feedback on ad creative, brief new concepts, and drive iteration based on performance data. Work with lifecycle/CRM, product, data science, and finance to align on audience strategy, budget, and measurement.

 - Own budget and forecasting: manage pacing across campaigns and markets, proactively reallocating spend to what’s working

 - Communicate with clarity: translate complex campaign data into sharp insights and recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years hands-on managing conversion-optimized paid social campaigns (must have specific paid social channel experience) with multi-million annual budget responsibility across major platforms

 - Strong grasp of web conversion campaigns — pixels, events, landing page performance, and full-funnel optimization

 - Experience running global campaigns across multiple geographies and markets

 - Experience with app campaign mechanics and mobile attribution (MMPs like Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust; SKAdNetwork, postbacks, etc.)

 - Sharp analytical skills: advanced in Excel, including pivot tables, with a track record of proactively running weekly and ad hoc analyses to diagnose performance and drive decisions — not just reporting on results, but getting ahead of them

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where channels, tools, and strategy evolve constantly

 - Nice to have: experience across a broad range of paid channels beyond the major social platforms (such as, X, Snapchat, Pinterest)




ADDITIONAL NOTES

 - Must be eligible to work in the US.

 - Must be willing to work 5 days/week in-office.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Marketing Campaigns
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director, Marketing Campaigns to lead the conception, development, and execution of bold, culture-shaping campaigns that bring Suno’s brand to life around the world. Reporting to the Head of Brand and Creative, you’ll set the creative vision for our marketing campaigns—translating Suno’s mission of unlocking music for everyone into ideas that move audiences, define moments, and drive growth.

In this role, you’ll lead an integrated creative practice that spans brand campaigns, product launches, partnerships, content franchises, and tentpole cultural moments. You’ll shape the work end-to-end—from insight and strategy to concept, craft, and final execution—partnering with designers, writers, art directors, producers, filmmakers, marketers, and external partners to ensure every output meets the highest creative bar.

This is a role for a seasoned creative leader who thinks like a strategist, makes like a maker, and inspires like a director. You’ve built campaigns that have entered the cultural conversation, and you know how to balance ambitious storytelling with the operational rigor that high-volume marketing requires. You bring a clear point of view, an eye for craft across every medium, and the instincts to know when an idea is ready to ship—and when it needs another pass.

Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/rPLk06OyhCHNKQrr

What You’ll Do

  • Set the creative vision for Suno’s marketing campaigns, developing a distinctive, ownable creative voice that scales across brand, product, partnerships, and cultural moments.

  • Lead the concepting and execution of integrated campaigns from insight to launch—owning the work across film, social, digital, OOH, experiential, partnerships, and emerging formats.

  • Partner with the Brand & Creative studio teams to evolve Suno’s brand expression, voice, and visual aesthetic, ensuring every campaign deepens equity and feels unmistakably Suno.

  • Direct and inspire a multidisciplinary team of art directors, designers, copywriters, producers, and external creative partners—building a high-trust environment where great ideas can come from anywhere.

  • Translate marketing and business objectives into creative briefs that unlock big ideas, with clear strategic intent and a sharp creative POV.

  • Pitch, sell, and shepherd ideas across the organization, presenting work persuasively to executive leadership and building cross-functional alignment around ambitious creative bets.

  • Lead production end-to-end, selecting and managing directors, photographers, animators, agencies, and production partners to deliver work at the highest level of craft.

  • Champion craft across every medium, holding a relentlessly high bar for writing, design, art direction, motion, sound, and storytelling.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Growth, Product Marketing, Social, Content, Communications, Partnerships, and Product to ensure campaigns ladder to business priorities and integrate seamlessly across channels.

  • Use cultural fluency and audience insight to identify the moments, formats, and collaborators that will make Suno’s work resonate—especially with creators, fans, and music communities.

  • Establish creative principles, processes, and rituals that protect the work, raise the bar over time, and help the creative team operate at its best.

  • Mentor and develop creative talent, growing the next generation of leaders within Suno’s creative organization.

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of experience leading creative for ambitious brands, with a portfolio of work spanning integrated campaigns, brand platforms, and culture-defining moments—ideally at a top creative agency, in-house brand, music or entertainment company, or consumer tech leader.

  • A standout body of work that demonstrates conceptual range, craft excellence, and the ability to drive cultural impact across media.

  • Proven experience as a creative leader who has built and inspired multidisciplinary teams of art directors, designers, writers, and producers.

  • Deep fluency across creative disciplines—art direction, copywriting, design, film, motion, photography, and emerging formats—with the ability to give precise, generative feedback at every stage of the work.

  • Track record of leading large-scale productions end-to-end, including selecting directors and partners, running shoots, and delivering across film, photography, social-first content, and experiential.

  • Strategic instincts: you can sit with ambiguity, identify the sharpest creative opportunity, and translate business objectives into ideas that travel.

  • Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to inspire executives, internal teams, and external collaborators around a shared creative vision.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, building trust with cross-functional partners across Growth, Product Marketing, Social, Content, Brand, Communications, and Product.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, high-ambition environment, balancing long-horizon brand building with the pace and volume of an always-on marketing org.

  • A point of view on culture, music, and creative technology—you understand where audiences are headed, and you’re excited to use AI and new tools as part of the creative process.

  • A passion for music, creativity, and emerging technology; you’re energized by leading the work that defines a category-creating brand.

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This is an in person role working at our NYC office

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

  • $212K- $263K

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 200 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

For most people, making music has always felt out of reach. Suno is changing that.

Millions of people are experiencing the joy of making music for the first time through Suno. We believe this is the beginning of a new category of consumer product, one where creating music becomes part of people’s everyday entertainment experience. Mobile will be the primary surface where this behavior takes shape.

We are seeking a Product Manager to lead the creation experience on mobile. This is a rare opportunity to shape how millions of people create music, helping make creativity feel effortless, expressive, and magical.

This role is ideal for a technical Product Manager who has significant experience building exceptional consumer mobile products at scale and wants to help build the next iconic app. You combine strong product intuition with deep empathy for users, a refined sense of taste, and a high bar for craft. You know how to move quickly, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and build products that delight millions of users.

Check out the Suno version of this role: https://suno.com/s/Y0WfEP7qALvaZanH

 

What You’ll Do

  • Reimagine music creation for mobile - Define the vision for how music is created, edited, explored, and shared on mobile. Invent new interaction patterns and workflows that make creating music feel intuitive, joyful, and accessible to everyone.

  • Build products people love - Lead the end-to-end development of consumer-facing features, from concept through launch and iteration. Create experiences that delight users while driving meaningful engagement and retention.

  • Shape the future of a new category - Identify emerging user behaviors and opportunities at the intersection of creativity, AI, and mobile consumer products. Translate those insights into ambitious product bets and clear roadmaps.

  • Champion craft and quality - Partner closely with Design and Engineering to deliver polished, high-quality experiences. Sweat the details while maintaining momentum and focus on outcomes.

  • Balance speed with scale - Make smart tradeoffs that enable rapid experimentation while building foundations that can support millions of users. Know when to move fast and when to invest for the long term.

  • Use data and intuition together - Combine product judgment, user research, and quantitative analysis to understand user needs and make informed decisions.

  • Collaborate across disciplines - Work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, User Research, and Product Marketing to bring innovative mobile experiences to market.

Who You Are

A product leader who is passionate about empowering creative expression:

  • 6+ years of experience in product management or related roles, with significant ownership of consumer mobile products

  • Proven track record of shipping successful mobile experiences at scale

  • Deep understanding of mobile product design, interaction patterns, and user behavior

  • Strong product taste and a demonstrated ability to make high-quality product decisions

  • Excited by ambiguity and energized by building entirely new product categories

  • Excellent communicator who can align teams around a clear vision

  • Strong analytical skills paired with exceptional user empathy

  • Passionate about consumer technology and building products that become part of people’s daily lives

  • Excited about the future of creation, music, and AI

  • Strong technical foundation, with a background in computer science, engineering, or a related field

Additional Notes

  • You must be authorized to work in the United States.

  • You must be willing to work 5 days per week at our Venice Beach office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $250K – $330K + target equity

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About the Role

We’re seeking a strategic, results-driven attorney to join our Product Legal team to support the product team as they innovate on the product roadmap. If you thrive in complex, fast-paced environments and are passionate about music, technology, and artificial intelligence, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, design and related teams to gain a comprehensive command of the product roadmap.

  • Provide full product life-cycle counseling, from ideation and development to launch and operation.

  • Identify and keep ahead of the evolving regulatory landscape by translating uncertainty into practical guidance.

  • Be (or become) an expert on a range of issues including intellectual property, AI, copyright, music, content safety, privacy, data protection, security, and advertising.

  • Develop and implement scaled legal processes to accelerate the company’s growth.

What You’ll Need

  • JD and in good standing with an active US state bar membership.

  • At least 8+ years of experience, with substantial in-house tech product experience, ideally with some experience with copyright and music.

  • Strong business acumen and ability to partner with business and technical teams.

  • An ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences

  • Hands-on attitude to tackle projects large and small, low-ego approach to working across the organization

  • Positive collaborative attitude, comfort with change and a fast pace, high level of integrity, and intellectual curiosity

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US
