About the Role

The Writing Camps Manager is the creative and technical heart of Suno's writing camps and studio activations, building engaging educational experiences for musicians, producers, songwriters, and artists. This role sits at the intersection of music production and technology, and assists participants in exploring how Suno can be integrated into their existing workflows to expand possibilities.

Working closely with the Artist Partnerships team, this role executes and scales writing camps and studio partnerships, ensuring each experience delivers exceptional creative outcomes while gathering insights that shape Suno's product roadmap. The Writing Camps Manager is equally comfortable in a recording studio as they are collaborating with product managers and engineers, and can effectively translate complex technical features into creative inspiration for top-tier musical talent.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/bTdygEUYMtCHYj1g

What You’ll Do

  • Execute end-to-end writing camp and studio activation experiences: managing technical setup, on-site logistics, and creative facilitation from pre-production through post-camp wrap

  • Serve as the primary liaison and educator during camps and studio activations, providing live demos, hands-on guidance, and real-time troubleshooting to help artists integrate Suno into their creative workflows

  • Demonstrate how AI tools can augment different stages of the music-making process, helping artists identify opportunities to accelerate ideation, production, and experimentation

  • Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to stay current on product developments, beta test new features in creative settings, and communicate artist needs and feedback

  • Document and synthesize learnings from each camp, translating artist feedback, technical issues, and creative discoveries into actionable product insights for internal teams

  • Support the Director of Artist Partnerships in refining camp and studio activation approaches based on hands-on learnings and artist feedback

  • Travel frequently to writing camps across the United States and occasionally internationally, managing all on-site production and technical elements

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of experience at music or technology companies, with ability to bridge creative and technical domains fluently

  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to distill technical concepts to creative audiences, and translate creative needs into technical requirements

  • Background as a musician, producer, and/or artist

  • Expert-level knowledge of music production, studio operations, recording techniques, and contemporary music-making workflows across multiple genres

  • Strong track record of building relationships with artists, producers, recording studio staff, music industry professionals, with credibility in creative communities

  • Passion for the intersection of music, creativity, and emerging technology, with genuine enthusiasm for empowering artists to explore how AI can serve as a creative tool in the hands of artists

  • Experience with Suno as a creative tool, or proven ability to rapidly master new music production platforms

  • Willingness to travel up to 80% for writing camps, studio activations, industry events, and meetings.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in product-focused roles at technology or music companies

  • B.S. degree in Music, Computer Science, or a related field

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US

  • Must be able to work 5 days per week at our New York office (when not traveling for writing camps or studio activations)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation:

$120,000 - $170,000 base salary (before equity)

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Social Impact & Education (Music)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno believes that Music is a Human Right, a vehicle for community, connection, healing, and learning. The Sr. Manager, Social Impact & Education ensures that Suno lives up to our belief.

This is a new role, an opportunity to define, build, and lead Suno's presence in two critically important spaces: the nonprofit and social impact community, and the educational institutions and platforms that are shaping how the next generation engages with music and technology. You will create the frameworks, forge the partnerships, and establish the practices that allow Suno to make a meaningful and lasting impact beyond the commercial platform.

You are a mission-driven operator: someone who knows how to translate big-picture vision into concrete programs, build trust with organizations that have high standards for the partners they choose, and move with the urgency and creativity that a fast-growing technology company demands. You believe that access to creative tools is a form of equity, and you want to spend your career proving it. This role initially reports to the Chief Music Officer.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/1JUK3wiiyx6X5FzJ

Here's an example of a recent partnership: https://songs-of-love.suno.com/

What You’ll Do

Social Impact & Nonprofit Partnerships

  • Develop and own Suno's social impact strategy, establishing a clear point of view on the communities, causes, and organizations we exist to serve

  • Identify, evaluate, and build relationships with nonprofits, community arts organizations, and mission-aligned institutions where Suno can have genuine, measurable impact

  • Design and manage partnership structures, including platform access programs, co-branded initiatives, and grant or donation frameworks, that make Suno meaningfully accessible to underserved communities

  • Serve as Suno's primary relationship manager for social impact partners, ensuring consistent communication, mutual value, and long-term commitment

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Comms, Legal, and Finance to bring programs to life and ensure they reflect Suno's values and brand

Education Partnerships

  • Build Suno's university and education strategy from the ground up, targeting institutions, music programs, and ed-tech platforms where AI music creation has natural curriculum relevance

  • Establish and manage formal partnerships with colleges, universities, and music schools, including access agreements, co-developed curriculum materials, and educator support resources

  • Identify and cultivate relationships with faculty, department heads, and academic administrators who can champion Suno's role in music education

  • Explore integrations and partnerships with established educational platforms and tools to extend Suno's reach into structured learning environments

  • Represent Suno at educational conferences, campus events, and relevant academic forums

Cross-Functional Impact

  • Work closely with Product to advocate for features and access tiers that serve nonprofit and educational users

  • Partner with Comms, Music, and Marketing teams to develop storytelling around Suno's social impact, surfacing the human stories that demonstrate our platform's reach and meaning

  • Own the annual social impact and education budget and investment recommendation, presenting priorities to senior leadership

  • Track and report on program performance, partnership health, and community impact metrics that inform Suno's broader social impact investment strategy

What You’ll Need

Required Experience & Expertise

  • 5-8+ years of experience in partnerships, program management, or community development, ideally spanning both education and nonprofit/social impact sectors

  • Demonstrated ability to build programs from scratch, you are comfortable with ambiguity and energized by the work of establishing something new

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the credibility to engage senior stakeholders at academic institutions and mission-driven organizations

  • Familiarity with the music industry, music education landscape, or AI technology (ideally more than one of these)

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills; you can represent Suno's vision compellingly to audiences who may be skeptical of or unfamiliar with AI

  • A genuine belief that creative tools should be accessible to everyone, and the drive to make that belief operational

  • Ability to manage multiple partnerships and workstreams simultaneously without losing attention to detail or relationship quality

  • Some people-manager experience; may manage internal or external partners supporting program execution in the future

Preferred

  • Experience at a music technology, streaming, or AI company

  • Experience working within or alongside product and engineering teams

  • Experience writing and/or performing music

  • Experience in product/platform product demonstrations

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This requires working 5 days per week at our NYC (Chelsea) office.

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation:

$175,000 - $235,000 base salary (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About the Role

Suno is looking for a Senior People Partner to be the strategic partner for a function or senior leader and their team. Reporting to the Director, People Business Partners, you’ll shape org design, talent strategy, and performance systems before decisions are made, not after, bringing judgment forged over years of doing this work to help senior leaders build teams that can keep pace with Suno’s growth. This is a role for someone who sees People work as performance architecture, not administration, and whose presence measurably improves how the leaders and teams around them operate.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as a trusted advisor to leaders and their teams, shaping org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy, and making the tradeoff calls that keep people and business priorities in balance.

  • Lead complex employee relations matters and high stakes performance situations end to end, helping leaders navigate situations with care, candor, and compliance.

  • Design and adapt company wide talent development programs from first principles, iterating in the open and working with external partners where needed. Manage the investment behind these programs and measure their impact on employees, not just whether they launched.

  • Coach leaders and managers through team scaling, reorgs, and performance complexity, questioning the assumptions behind their decisions and staying comfortable operating without a clean playbook.

  • Build and maintain tools, model and resources in Excel and Claude, using workforce data, sentiment, talent reviews, and outside research, to spot capability gaps, workforce costs, and succession risks. Diagnose the root cause, not just the symptom, and deliver a fix that lasts.

  • Proactively build relationships across the functions, earning trust through how you show up in the room, mentoring less experienced People partners with a mix of competitive drive and camaraderie that raises the bar for the whole team.

What You’ll Need

Must-Haves

  • 6+ years of experience as a People Partner, with demonstrated depth partnering with senior leaders in a high growth tech environment.

  • Track record leading complex employee relations investigations and high stakes performance situations independently.

  • Sophistication in org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy.

  • Strong grounding in US employment law, including Title VII, ADA, and FMLA; comfortable operating with independence and good judgment at the senior leadership level.

  • Proven ability to translate company-wide People frameworks into a specific function’s context without losing the intent behind them.

  • Hands on with AI tools and motivated to build AI enhanced People workflows.

  • Strong Excel skills and strong analytical fluency with People data. Comfortable building and interpreting your own models, not just reading someone else's dashboard.

  • Project management skills and a proven record of executing and building things on the go, not just planning them.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building or significantly improving a People program, such as performance management, career progression, or compensation, with real interest in owning that kind of build as part of your remit.

  • Experience partnering with Finance on headcount budgeting and workforce modeling.

  • Track record leading complex, cross functional programs end to end, multiple workstreams and competing deadlines, shipped and adopted, not just launched.

  • Experience designing or scaling learning and development or talent management programs, such as succession planning or leadership development.

  • Familiarity with California employment law, useful given Suno's presence in Los Angeles and San Francisco.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno’s company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • Willingness to travel (up to 10%) to collaborate with team members across Suno office locations.

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno is looking for a Senior People Partner to be the strategic partner for a function or senior leader and their team. Reporting to the Director, People Business Partners, you’ll shape org design, talent strategy, and performance systems before decisions are made, not after, bringing judgment forged over years of doing this work to help senior leaders build teams that can keep pace with Suno’s growth. This is a role for someone who sees People work as performance architecture, not administration, and whose presence measurably improves how the leaders and teams around them operate.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Act as a trusted advisor to leaders and their teams, shaping org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy, and making the tradeoff calls that keep people and business priorities in balance.

 - Lead complex employee relations matters and high stakes performance situations end to end, helping leaders navigate situations with care, candor, and compliance.

 - Design and adapt company wide talent development programs from first principles, iterating in the open and working with external partners where needed. Manage the investment behind these programs and measure their impact on employees, not just whether they launched.

 - Coach leaders and managers through team scaling, reorgs, and performance complexity, questioning the assumptions behind their decisions and staying comfortable operating without a clean playbook.

 - Build and maintain tools, model and resources in Excel and Claude, using workforce data, sentiment, talent reviews, and outside research, to spot capability gaps, workforce costs, and succession risks. Diagnose the root cause, not just the symptom, and deliver a fix that lasts.

jobs.title: Senior Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (CRO Marketing)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

 

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert — and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

 

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself — grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

What You'll Do

  • Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them

  • Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves

  • Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding

  • Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions

  • Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast

  • Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand

  • Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why

  • Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context

  • Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic

  • Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting

  • Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

Qualifications

  • You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you

  • 5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)

  • You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them

  • You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next

  • You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar

  • You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business

  • You use AI to get more done than one person normally could

  • You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC.

Compensation

$160k - $190k base salary (before equity)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Lead Security Engineer to help build the security foundation. This is a hands-on role: you’ll set technical direction for security across our product and infrastructure, go deep in the code and the cloud yourself, and help shape the team that grows around you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own security architecture and the roadmap across our product and cloud environments, threat-modeling to focus effort where it matters most.

  • Elevate our AppSec practice: secure the SDLC, establish code-review guardrails, manage dependencies and secrets, and implement pre-production security testing.

  • Drive cloud security: IAM and least-privilege, account structure, network boundaries, and data-access controls.

  • Lead incident response. This role requires participation in an on-call rotation and acting as the senior responder during incidents.

  • Mentor and shape the security team and its operational processes.

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years in security engineering, with deep expertise in at least two of AppSec, cloud/infrastructure security, and IR, and credibility in the third.

  • A builder: you’ve created security capabilities and set direction, not only operated established programs.

  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills — security should enable the business to build and operate safely.

  • Nice to have: Consumer product at scale, AI/ML abuse or model-security exposure, experience as an early or founding security hire.


Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

  • This role requires working onsite at one of our three offices.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior / Staff Detection & Response Engineer to design and own how we detect and respond to threats across our environment — the telemetry, the detections, the playbooks, and the on-call rotation. This is a hands-on senior role for an engineer who wants to build detection and response the right way from the ground up and own it end to end.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build our detection and telemetry pipeline, including logging coverage, the detection stack, and the data that feeds it.

  • Write high-signal detections mapped to the threats that matter most, starting with the paths that lead to a breach: identity, access, the cloud control plane, and data exfiltration.

  • Build and own incident response — playbooks, on-call, live response, and post-incident reviews that make us better each time.

  • Partner with security and platform engineering to close telemetry gaps and instrument what isn’t yet visible.

  • Set the bar for detection-as-code and a metrics-driven approach to response.

  • Build detection for AI-specific abuse and threats and novel attack patterns as they emerge.

  • Leverage AI to augment yourself so you can focus on the critical work that only you can do.


What You’ll Need

  • 6+ years in detection and response, including building detection capability and setting direction — not only operating an established one.

  • Strong AWS-native detection depth (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC/flow logs, and the broader ecosystem).

  • A detection-as-code, engineering-first mindset.

  • Calm, structured, and decisive in a live incident.

  • Interest in detecting emerging AI/ML abuse and threat patterns.

  • Nice to have: Consumer product at scale, experience as an early or founding detection hire, exposure to AI/ML abuse or platform-abuse signals.


Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working onsite at one of our three offices.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior / Staff Application Security Engineer to own the security of how our product is built. You’ll be the person who makes sure our code, APIs, and services are secure by design — threat-modeling the product, hardening the application layer, and building the AppSec practice from the ground up.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute application security end to end: threat-model features and services, and drive remediation of the most significant risks.

  • Secure the application layer against the vulnerabilities that matter most — injection, broken authentication and authorization, and insecure APIs.

  • Build and run a secure SDLC: code-review guardrails, SAST/DAST, dependency and supply-chain security, secrets management, and pre-production testing.

  • Harden authentication, authorization, and session/identity handling across the product.

  • Secure the AI-specific application surface — model and inference endpoints, prompt and input handling, and the new classes of vulnerability that come with shipping generative features.

  • Partner with product and platform engineering to design security in early and raise the security bar across the codebase.

  • Set the standard for how engineering reasons about and ships secure code.


What You’ll Need

  • 6+ years in security engineering with deep, hands-on application-security expertise.

  • Strong command of the vulnerability classes that cause incidents and how to eliminate them at the source — code, API, and authz design.

  • A builder who has stood up AppSec practices and secure-SDLC tooling, not only operated established ones.

  • Fluent in modern application stacks and comfortable in AWS.

  • Able to work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and raise the bar without becoming a blocker.

  • Able to write and ship production-quality code, not only review it.

  • Curiosity about emerging AI/LLM threat classes and how to defend against them as the product evolves.

  • Nice to have: Consumer product at scale, secure-by-design work on generative-AI or ML product surfaces, and/or early security-hire experience.


Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working onsite at one of our three offices.

Compensation:

  • $230,000 to 330,000

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Program Lead, Suno Emerging Creator Program (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Program

Suno's mission is amplifying creativity for people everywhere. Having built strong traction with emerging musicians and producers, our next opportunity is the content creator economy. Suno’s new Emerging Creator Program launches that effort: developing the next generation of creators while establishing Suno as a company that accelerates creative careers.

The program is a selective, cohort-based 12-week experience for a cohort of nano and micro creators building careers around content. Members get access to exclusive programming including Suno workshops and keynotes from breakout creators, plus creative contests, content spotlights, IRL events, and a network of fellow creators. At the end of the program, we aim to sign a few participants for ongoing deals with Suno, maintain an active community of creators, and scale the initiative beyond the pilot phase.

The Role

You'll be the operational engine of the program: building it from the ground up alongside the Suno team through August and September, then running it end-to-end through December. You'll own the calendar, the cohort experience, the speakers, the events, and all of the details in between. In this role you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with Growth and Influencer marketing, Music partnerships and Creative to turn this from strategy and vision into reality.

What You'll Do

Build

  • Translate the program outline into a week-by-week curriculum: session formats, Suno skills/tools coverage, contest design for off weeks

  • Build and manage the guest speaker pipeline: identify, pitch, confirm, and prep breakout-creator speakers and mentors

  • Stand up program infrastructure: community channel (Slack/Discord), calendar, meeting/tech setup, application intake and tracking

  • Support outreach and sourcing: manage the handpicked invite list, Spark referrals, and application pipeline; run logistics for the selection process (Sept 7–18)

  • Determine application approach, launch messaging, and launch-creator partnership

  • Source and negotiate member perks with partner tools and brands

  • Coordinate internal reviews (including legal review of contest mechanics, creator payments, event liability, and minors)

Run

  • Own the biweekly programming cadence end-to-end: scheduling, speaker coordination, session production, follow-ups

  • Run monthly creative contests: briefs, submission tracking, judging logistics, prize fulfillment

  • Design and manage the creator spotlight approach

  • Produce IRL moments if applicable

  • Be the day-to-day face of the program for members: onboarding, questions, nudges, community management, keeping energy high

  • Track program health: attendance, participation, contest engagement, member sentiment; flag at-risk members early

Assess

  • Produce the graduation moment: credentialing, culmination for participants

  • Transition the cohort into the alumni network

  • Deliver a program retro: what worked, what didn't, and a recommended blueprint for cohort 2

Who You Are

  • You've operated programs like this before: 3+ years running cohort-based programs, creator/community programs, accelerators, fellowships, or high-touch event series, ideally you’ve built one from scratch.

  • You know the creator economy: You understand how nano/micro creators think about growth, money, brands, and community and you can talk to them credibly. Bonus: you've worked with creator programs, MCNs, talent management, or platform partnerships

  • You're an ops machine: Calendars, run-of-shows, trackers, follow-ups. You're the person who notices the Zoom link is wrong before anyone joins

  • You’re hospitality-minded and a strong experience designer: Members should feel the program is run by someone who gets them. You create belonging, and intuitively know what people need and how to serve them.

  • You work autonomously: You are excited by ambiguity and the ability to create structure from guardrails. You’re communicative, independent and reliable.

  • Bonus: experience producing IRL events; familiarity with Suno or AI creative tools; existing relationships with breakout creators or creator communities

What Success Looks Like

  • Program launches on time at full capacity

  • 12 weeks of programming run smoothly with strong attendance and completion

  • Members describe the program as career-changing, say so publicly

  • A documented playbook that makes cohort 2 easier, bigger, or better

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Marketing Designer, Performance Creative (Contractor)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

 

About the Role

Suno is growing fast, and paid social creative is a major driver of that growth. The right person for this role takes Suno's brand identity and pushes it into performance creative that earns attention and converts – work that drives growth and brings the excitement of using Suno to everyone who sees it.

As Graphic Designer on the Performance Marketing team, you'll own the branded paid social creative pipeline: conceiving, producing, and iterating on work across branded static formats. You'll work closely with the performance marketing team, treating data and channel insights as creative inputs rather than afterthoughts. Over time, you'll help build the workflows and systems that let us scale without losing what makes Suno's creative distinctive. As the team grows, there's a path to managing other creative contributors.

 

Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax

 

What You'll Do

  • Translate Suno's brand identity and creative DNA into paid social creative that drives growth across paid channels (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)

  • Own the full branded creative pipeline – concepting, producing, and iterating on branded static assets

  • Build and maintain a creative roadmap: what to make, what to test, what to push further, and what to move on from

  • Partner with the performance marketing team to use data and channel feedback as creative inputs, not just outputs

  • Use AI tools to extend creative output beyond what's manually possible – and help build the processes and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on-brand and up to Suno's standards

  • Develop workflows and production processes that scale creative output without diluting brand quality

  • Help shape how the next generation of creators discovers Suno – the creative you make is often their first impression



What You'll Need

  • 4-6 years in performance creative, paid social design, or growth-focused creative at a consumer tech, DTC, or growth-stage company

  • Expert graphic design skills: strong static design fundamentals and a sharp eye for details and consumer psychology

  • Portfolio of paid social work that demonstrates both craft and a performance orientation

  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, etc.

  • Fluency in what makes paid social creative work: hooks, formats, platform conventions, and what drives meaningful iteration

  • Ability to internalize a brand's visual identity and push it into new formats without losing what makes it distinctive

 

Compensation

$75 - $90 per hour

 

Additional Notes

20-40 hours per week

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager, Consumer Subscription
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're hiring a Product Manager to drive consumer revenue at Suno, the surfaces where free users become subscribers and subscribers decide to stay. This includes our purchase and upgrade flows, paywalls, pricing page, offers, and winback flows.

This is a rare seat. Suno is one of the fastest-growing consumer subscription products, and the conversion and retention systems that got us here are still early. Your job is to run that consumer revenue engine faster and better than we can today, and to keep making it smarter: better hypotheses, better instrumentation, better infrastructure, and better experimentation velocity.

You'll report to the Head of Revenue Product and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Growth, and User Acquisition. This is a high-ownership IC role on the company's most direct revenue lever, with room to grow as the revenue product function scales.

Check out the Suno version of this role: https://suno.com/s/puBwsqAPQEz8AMng

What You’ll Do

  • Own the consumer conversion and retention experience end to end: purchase and upgrade flows, paywalls, pricing page, offers, and winback flows

  • Drive key consumer revenue KPIs: free-to-paid conversion, subscriber churn, ARPU and plan mix, and consumer subscription revenue

  • Develop a rigorous A/B testing strategy to validate hypotheses around conversion, paywalls, user education, and feature adoption

  • Own the conversion system that our acquisition channels plug into, partnering with performance marketing on landing pages to create a coherent click-to-purchase experience

  • Invest in experimentation velocity including the processes, infrastructure/tooling, and AI-assisted workflows that let the team test more, learn faster, and trust the results

  • Translate user research and behavioral data, qualitative and quantitative, into structured test plans with clear hypotheses and success criteria

  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Growth Marketing to ship quickly without sacrificing quality or user trust

  • Communicate results, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to the team and to leadership

What You'll Need

Must-Have

  • You have a strong track record of delivering impactful product launches and improvements. You ideally have 5+ years of relevant work experience at a consumer subscription or freemium product: growth product management with potentially some adjacent experience in a data-centric role (data science, strategy and operations, etc) or growth marketing role

  • You are data-driven, leaning heavily on both qualitative and quantitative data to inform product prioritization and decision making. You care about the balance between craft, speed, and business outcomes

  • You’re a team player with a growth mindset, collaborating effectively with other teams and influencing without authority

  • You think in systems, not one-off tests. You can connect an individual paywall experiment to the pricing and packaging architecture it lives inside

  • You balance monetization with user trust. You know the difference between a conversion win and what’s best for our users.

This role reports to the Chief Commercial Officer and sits at the intersection of music, technology, and AI. It requires expertise in music publishing, extensive negotiation experience, comfort operating without a playbook, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives across product, legal, finance, operations, and partnerships. This is a senior individual contributor role.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/RmEpEZqAe9G5vBpo

What You’ll Do

  • Support Suno’s commercial strategy for partnerships with companies in the music industry, driving alignment across product, legal, finance, and operations

  • Negotiate and close deals with publishers, including first-of-kind deal structures in a category that is still being defined

  • Build and maintain senior-level relationships with such companies to expand Suno’s reputation and credibility

  • Monitor the competitive and evolving landscape in AI music, advising leadership on market dynamics, industry engagement strategy, and partnership opportunities

  • Develop scalable approaches to contract management, partner operations, and long-term industry collaboration

  • Support strategic initiatives across ecosystem partnerships, and platform integrations as Suno’s commercial footprint grows

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of experience in business development and/or commercial negotiations within the music and digital technology space

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating and closing complex, high-value deals, including forging first-of-a-kind partnerships

  • Experience working with music publishers

  • Strong track record of influencing and aligning stakeholders across multiple levels, including executive leadership

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

  • Proven ability to execute multiple high-priority projects simultaneously

  • High degree of autonomy, ownership, and strategic judgment; comfort navigating situations where there is no established playbook

  • Strong product intuition and experience collaborating closely with product and technical teams

  • Experience operating effectively in fast-paced, high-growth technology environments

 

Additional Notes

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working onsite at our LA or NYC offices.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

About the Role

Suno's paid search program spans every international market we operate in, and it needs someone who can bring both rigor and range to its management. As our SEM Manager, you'll own paid search acquisition strategy, signaling, and testing across Google, Bing, and Apple Search Ads while joining our Growth Marketing team at a time when speed and exploration is key. You'll work closely with our SEM Lead, Paid Social, Data Science, Finance, and Creative teams to scale enterprise-level accounts with the depth of nuance and structure it requires.

This role is designed for someone with high accountability, desire for ownership, and has proven effectiveness at-scale. You’ve managed +$20M annual budgets with a deep comfort in digging through large data sets, managing bid/budgets globally, creative testing, and executing for alpha via recurring optimizations. You are responsible for identifying growth opportunities and driving efficiency across one of Suno’s key acquisition channels.

Here’s a song we made about it:

https://suno.com/s/knk1K1XI28KqQaAi

What You'll Do

  • Manage SEM suite: Scope spans a full array of networks from Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Apple Search Ads, and beyond. Manage budgets, bids, and audience strategy/structure to consistently drive towards our KPI targets.

  • Own Channel Performance Globally: Optimize campaigns driving new users, subscriptions, and team acquisition KPIs across web and app surfaces in multiple geographic markets with nuance and attention.

  • Drive KPIs using the full scope of campaign types: Meet users where they are and optimize funnel from first impression to subscription. Understand audience overlap and cross-channel pollination to maximize impact not just of your directly managed campaigns, but the overall effectiveness of a market or initiative.

  • Own analysis and reporting: Proactively dig into campaign performance and anomalies to diagnose trends and deliver actionable insights to the growth team.

  • Build your own tools: Leverage AI, internal tools, and data pipelines to remove blockers in your day-to-day. When something is broken or a desired dashboard doesn’t exist, try building the functionality yourself first rather than waiting for sprint backlogs from other teams.

  • Collaborate Cross-functionally: Share copy/keyword insights back and forth with the Creative and Lifecycle teams. Solve data gaps with the Engineering team. Answer the impregnable questions with the Data science team.

  • Own Channel partner relationship: own the relationship with channel reps, including beta access, product roadmap input, billing, and spend reconciliation.

  • Develop Testing Roadmap: Leverage industry, partner, and personal knowledge to identify the areas of deficiency or untapped potential. Always aware of the latest platform betas and which are useful/irrelevant. Not afraid of learning phases or testing entirely new directions in campaign structure.

What You'll Need

  • 4+ years of experience in SEM / paid search.

  • Deep platform expertise and understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, and cross-channel overlap.

  • Experience managing large media budgets, with examples to share.

  • Background in highly competitive industries.

  • International campaign management experience - specifically in non-english markets.

  • Experience with UAC dynamics/nuance with understanding of MMPs for attribution modeling/tracking.

  • Hands-on expertise with Bulk & Offline Editors for large-scale account management.

  • Track record across reporting, bid management, and test planning.

  • Comfort operating with goal ambiguity, and the ability to explain SEM auction and trend nuance clearly and concisely to other teams.

  • Strong cross-functional collaborator, especially with Data and Engineering partners.

  • A collaborative instinct where you lean on teammates for context and support rather than guessing.

  • Comfort using Claude (including Claude Code) or similar AI tools to speed up and sharpen day-to-day work.

  • Composure when working through complex datasets or ambiguous problems.

  • Nice to have: High proficiency in Excel; SQL is a plus.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days per week in our NYC office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is: $104k -$170k (before equity)

 - Manage SEM suite: Scope spans a full array of networks from Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Apple Search Ads, and beyond. Manage budgets, bids, and audience strategy/structure to consistently drive towards our KPI targets.

 - Own Channel Performance Globally: Optimize campaigns driving new users, subscriptions, and team acquisition KPIs across web and app surfaces in multiple geographic markets with nuance and attention.

 - Drive KPIs using the full scope of campaign types: Meet users where they are and optimize funnel from first impression to subscription. Understand audience overlap and cross-channel pollination to maximize impact not just of your directly managed campaigns, but the overall effectiveness of a market or initiative.

 - Own analysis and reporting: Proactively dig into campaign performance and anomalies to diagnose trends and deliver actionable insights to the growth team.

 - Build your own tools: Leverage AI, internal tools, and data pipelines to remove blockers in your day-to-day. When something is broken or a desired dashboard doesn’t exist, try building the functionality yourself first rather than waiting for sprint backlogs from other teams.

 - Collaborate Cross-functionally: Share copy/keyword insights back and forth with the Creative and Lifecycle teams. Solve data gaps with the Engineering team. Answer the impregnable questions with the Data science team.

 - Own Channel partner relationship: own the relationship with channel reps, including beta access, product roadmap input, billing, and spend reconciliation.

 - 4+ years of experience in SEM / paid search.

 - Deep platform expertise and understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, and cross-channel overlap.

 - Experience managing large media budgets, with examples to share.

 - International campaign management experience - specifically in non-english markets.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Conversion
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

 

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert — and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

 

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself — grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

What You'll Do

  • Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them

  • Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves

  • Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding

  • Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions

  • Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast

  • Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand

  • Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why

  • Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context

  • Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic

  • Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting

  • Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

Qualifications

  • You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you

  • 5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)

  • You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them

  • You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next

  • You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar

  • You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business

  • You use AI to get more done than one person normally could

  • You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC.

Compensation

$160k - $190k base salary (before equity)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

The Director of Editorial role at Suno is a leadership position that will help establish the framework and POV of editorial at Suno. We are growing a generational company

The ideal candidate is someone who…

  • Lives and breathes a diverse range of music

  • Attends live shows regularly

  • Has deep relationships across labels, artists, managers, and the broader music ecosystem

  • Is A trusted taste-maker whose recommendations people seek out — friends, colleagues, and industry contacts alike

  • Is fluent in how music moves online: platforms, subcultures, meme-to-mainstream pipelines, and how virality and quality intersect

  • Is comfortable being both a strategist and a doer — equally at ease setting editorial vision and personally selecting tracks for a playlist

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/UR6HQyggM89GakwE

What You’ll Do

  • Set the editorial vision for how music is discovered and celebrated within Suno, including in-app playlist curation, artist spotlights, and genre, style and mood taxonomy

  • Oversee the development and maintenance of Suno's curation frameworks — ensuring the platform's musical taxonomy reflects both the breadth of Suno's community and the evolving landscape of AI-generated music

  • Champion artist spotlights and features as a meaningful touchpoint for community recognition and platform storytelling

  • Ensure editorial decisions are informed by data, community feedback, and cultural context, balancing algorithmic signals with human taste

  • Help build and lead the editorial team, including hiring, mentoring, and setting the standards for how curators evaluate and select music

  • Work collaboratively with and earn the trust of the current members of the team, rather than disrupting the ecosystem on Day 1

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define how editorial signals (human curation) and algorithmic recommendation systems work together, rather than in competition

  • Develop a POV on how music made with Suno should be evaluated editorially — what "quality" and "originality" mean in this context, and how that differs from (or resembles) traditional A&R judgment

  • Manage editorial balance between music made with Suno and music licensed for Suno

  • Drive editorial not only from the lens of discovery but also engagement/remixing

  • Represent Suno's editorial voice externally — in artist and label conversations, press, and partnerships — as a credible authority on music discovery

  • Define and track success metrics for editorial programs (engagement, retention, artist satisfaction) and report on program impact to leadership

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of experience in A&R, editorial, or a related field within the music industry

  • A genuine point of view on music curation, discovery, and what makes an editorial program feel authentic and culturally resonant

  • Strong operational instincts with experience building and improving processes across marketing or editorial workflows

  • AI fluency, or at the very least curiosity and fair review of music made with AI-assistance

  • Familiarity with metadata and taxonomy systems

  • Excellent communicator: able to represent Suno credibly with senior artist teams and external partners, and communicate clearly and directly internally

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by the pace and possibility of a high-growth environment

  • Passion for music and sincere belief in technology's potential to expand creative access and expression

  • A roll-up-your-sleeves mentality as we grow rapidly and are building a generational company

  • A passion for music, culture, and creativity, with a finger on the pulse of industry trends.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally across multiple teams (marketing, brand, creative, growth, engineering) that are growing rapidly

Preferred

  • Experience at a streaming, publication, or AI company

  • Familiarity with music taxonomy, metadata, or editorial curation systems

  • Experience working within or alongside product and engineering teams

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Additional Notes:

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

  • This role requires working onsite at one of our offices.

 

Compensation:

The annual salary range for this role is $200,000 – $263,000

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Social Media Community Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Social Media Community Manager to be the voice of Suno across our social platforms and the daily connective tissue between our fans, creators, and brand. This is a full time role reporting to the Director of Social Media, and it sits at the heart of how Suno shows up in culture—shaping the tone, energy, and relationships that turn casual listeners into passionate advocates.

In this role, you’ll live inside our comments, DMs, replies, and community spaces—engaging with Suno’s audience in a way that feels human, witty, and unmistakably on-brand. You’ll partner closely with the social, brand, and content teams to surface cultural moments, amplify creators, and translate community signal into insight that shapes how we talk and what we make. You’ll help build a community that feels alive, inclusive, and creatively inspired.

This is a role for someone who genuinely loves the internet—who can spot a meme before it peaks, write a reply that earns a screenshot, and spark conversations that make people feel seen. You understand the rhythm of platforms like TikTok, Instagram, X, and Reddit, and you move with the speed and fluency that real-time community work demands. You’re equally comfortable celebrating a creator’s moment, defusing a tense thread, and turning a random comment into a reason for a thousand more.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/D0jCWAkn2JR4Kzik

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day community engagement across Suno’s social channels (TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms), responding to comments, DMs, and mentions in a voice that is distinctly Suno.

  • Build genuine relationships with Suno creators and superfans—celebrating their work, surfacing their songs, and helping them feel recognized as part of the Suno story.

  • Spot cultural moments, memes, and trends in real time and partner with the social team to jump on them quickly with on-brand, high-quality responses.

  • Moderate community spaces (Discord, Reddit, comments sections) with care and good judgment—keeping conversations healthy, welcoming, and aligned with our community guidelines.

  • Act as the first line of listening for the brand—tracking sentiment, surfacing emerging themes, and escalating issues, bugs, or sensitive conversations to the appropriate teams.

  • Drive a proactive social listening practice—monitoring conversations across owned channels, broader social platforms, and creator communities to identify recurring themes, sentiment shifts, white-space opportunities, and early signals of issues.

  • Translate those themes into clear, prioritized actions: content ideas for the social team, talking points for brand and PR, product feedback for the Suno team, creator outreach opportunities, and adjustments to community strategy. Share these insights through regular readouts so listening consistently turns into decisions and meaningful follow-through.

  • Partner with the Director of Social Media to shape community strategy, contribute to content ideas, and help plan engagement around launches, campaigns, and cultural moments.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, Support, and Trust & Safety to ensure community feedback informs how we build, communicate, and respond.

About Suno
